ijwi rimwe mu nama zose z'Umuryango, mu
nama za Komite mpuzamahanga ngishwanama
yitabiriye, kandi iyo ari umunyamuryango
w'Inama y'Ubutegetsi, agira ijwi rimwe mu
nama zose z'iyo Nama.
14. (3) Buri Munyamuryango shingiro kandi
agira ijwi rimwe mu nama zose zikorwa mu
buryo bw'inyandiko.
15. 2. Abanyamuryango bungirije bafite
uburenganzira n’inshingano
nk’iby’abanyamuryango b’Umuryango, usibye
ko badafite uburenganzira bwo gutora mu nama
iyo ari yo yose cyangwa izindi nzego
z’Umuryango cyangwa gutanga abakandida
bagomba kuba abanyamuryango b’Ikigo
mpuzamahanga gishinzwe kwandika imirongo
y’Itumanaho. Ntibashobora kwemererwa
gutorwa mu Nama y’Ubutegetsi.

articles.heading: Icyicaro cy'Umuryango 16. Icyicaro cy’Umuryango kiba i Jeneve
Intego z'Umuryango 17. 1. Intego z’Umuryango ni
articles.text:
(a) gusigasira no kwagura ubufatanye
mpuzamahanga hagamijwe kunoza no
gukoresha neza itumanaho ry’ubwoko bwose;
18. (b) gushyigikira iterambere ry'ibikoresho
by'ikoranabuhanga n'imikorere yabyo mu
buryo bwiza bushoboka, hagamijwe kurushaho
kunoza imikorere myiza ya serivisi
z'itumanaho, kuzamura akamaro kazo no
kuzigeza ku bantu muri rusange uko bishoboka
kose;
19. (c) guhuza ibikorwa by'ibihugu mu kugera
kuri izo ntego rusange.
20. 2. Ku bw’ibyo, Umuryango ugomba
by’umwihariko:
(a) gushyiraho uburyo bwo gutanga umurongo
w’itumanaho no kwandika imirongo yahawe
abayikoresha kugira ngo hirindwe kwivanga
kw’imirongo y’amaradiyo y’ibihugu
bitandukanye ;
21. (b) guhuza imbaraga mu rwego rwo
gukumira ukwivanga gufite ingaruka mbi
hagati ya sitasiyo za radiyo zo mu bihugu
bitandukanye no kunoza ikoreshwa ry'imirongo
ya radiyo;
22. (c) gushyigikira ubufatanye hagati
y'abanyamuryango shingiro bawo
n'abanyamuryango bungirije hagamijwe
gushyiraho ibyiciro by’imishahara biri ku
gipimo cyo hasi gishoboka gihuje na serivisi
zikora neza kandi hitabwa ku kamaro ko
gusigasira imicungire yigenga y’imari
y’itumanaho ishingiye ku musingi ukomeye
kandi uhamye;
23. (d) gushyigikira ishyirwaho, iterambere no
kunoza ibikoresho n'imiyoboro by'itumanaho
mu bihugu bishya cyangwa biri mu nzira
y'amajyambere hakoreshejwe uburyo bwose
buhari, by’umwihariko uruhare rwayo mu
kwitabira gahunda ziboneye z’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye;
24. (e) gushishikariza ko hafatwa ingamba zo
kurinda ubuzima bw'abantu binyuze mu
bufatanye bw'imirimo y'itumanaho;
25. (f) gukora ubushakashatsi, gushyiraho
amabwiriza, gufata imyanzuro, gutanga inama
n'ibitekerezo no gukusanya no gutangaza
amakuru ajyanye n'ibibazo by'itumanaho ku
nyungu z'Abanyamuryango shingiro bose
n'Abanyamuryango bungirije.

articles.heading: Imiterere y'Umuryango 26. Imitunganyirize y’Umuryango iteye ku buryo bukurikira
Inama y’abahawe ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu 33. 1. Inama y’abahawe ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu, urwego rukuru rw’Umuryango, igizwe
articles.text:
n’intumwa zihagarariye Abanyamuryango
shingiro n’abanyamuryango bungirije.
34. 2. Inama y’abahawe ububasha bahagarariye
ibihugu igomba:
(a) kugena politiki rusange yo gusohoza intego
z’Umuryango ziteganyijwe mu ngingo ya 4
y’aya Masezerano;
35. (b) gusuzuma raporo y’Inama y’Ubutegetsi
ku bikorwa byayo n’iby’Umuryango kuva ku
Nama y’abahawe ububasha bahagarariye
ibihugu iheruka ;
36. (c) gushyiraho ishingiro ry'ingengo y'imari
y'Umuryango no gushyiraho ingengo y'imari
ntarengwa y'Umuryango kugeza ku nama
y'Inama y’abahawe ububasha bahagarariye
ibihugu ikurikira;
37. (d) Gushyiraho imishahara fatizo, ibyiciro
by’imishahara, hamwe na sisiteme y’ibindi
bitangwa n’imperekeza ku bakozi bose
b’Umuryango ;
38. (e) kwemeza burundu amakonte
y’Umuryango ;
39. (f) gutora Abagize Umuryango bagomba
gukorera mu Nama y’Ubutegetsi;
40. (g) gutora Umunyamabanga Mukuru
n’Umunyamabanga Mukuru wungirije no
kugena amatariki batangirira gukora akazi;
41. (h) kuvugurura Amasezerano iyo ibona ari
ngombwa;
42. (i) gushyiraho cyangwa kuvugurura, iyo
bibaye ngombwa, amasezerano hagati
y'Umuryango n'indi miryango mpuzamahanga,
gusuzuma amasezerano y'agateganyo ayo ari yo
yose ugirana n'iyo miryango, mu izina
ry'Umuryango, bikozwe n’Inama y’Ubutegetsi
no gufata ingamba zijyanye n'ayo masezerano
iyo bikwiye.
43. (j) gukemura ibindi bibazo by’itumanaho
iyo bikenewe.
44. 3. Inama y’abahawe ububasha bahagarariye
ibihugu ubusanzwe iterana ku munsi n’ahantu
byemejwe n’Inama iheruka .
45. 4. Itariki n’ahazabera Inama y’abahawe
ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu ikurikira,
cyangwa kimwe muri byo, gishobora
guhindurwa :
46. (a) iyo byibuze kimwe cya kane
cy’abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije basabye ubwabo
Umunyamabanga Mukuru impinduka,
cyangwa,
47. (b) ku busabe bw'Inama y'Ubutegetsi.
48. (2) Muri kimwe muri ibyo bihe, itariki
nshya cyangwa ahazabera inama, cyangwa
byombi, bigomba kwemezwa mu bwumvikane
bushingiye ku bwiganze bw’abanyamuryango
b’Umuryango.

articles.heading: Inama z'Ubutegetsi 49. 1. Inama z’Ubutegetsi z’Umuryango zigizwe
articles.text:
(a) inama z'ubuyobozi ku isi;
50. (b) inama z'ubuyobozi mu karere.
51. 2. Inama z’Ubutegetsi ubusanzwe ziterana
kugira ngo zisuzume ibibazo by’itumanaho
byihariye. Gusa ibintu biri muri gahunda zayo
ni byo byonyine bishobora kuganirwaho mu
nama nk’izo. Ibyemezo by'izo nama mu bihe
byose bigomba kuba bihuye n'ibiteganywa n’
aya Masezerano.
52. 3. (1) Gahunda y’inama y’ubutegetsi ku isi
yose ishobora kuba ikubiyemo:
(a) gusubiramo igice cy’amabwiriza
y’ubutegetsi yanditse muri nomero 203;
53. (b) Mu bihe bidasanzwe, hashobora
gukorwa isubirwamo rusange ry’amwe
cyangwa yose muri ayo Mabwiriza.
54. (c) Ikindi kibazo icyo ari cyo cyose gifite
ireme mpuzamahanga kiri mu bubasha
bw’inama.
55. (2) Gahunda y’inama y’ubutegetsi ku rwego
rw’akarere ishobora kubamo gusa ibibazo
byihariye by’itumanaho bifite imiterere
y’akarere, harimo n’amabwiriza agenga Ikigo
Mpuzamahanga gishinzwe kwandika
imikoreshereze y’imirongo y’itumanaho,
ajyanye n’ibikorwa byayo mu karere kavugwa,
ariko ayo mabwiriza ntagongana n’inyungu
z’utundi turere. Ikindi kandi, ibyemezo by’iyo
nama bigomba guhora bihuye n’ibiteganywa
n’Amabwiriza y’ubutegetsi.
56. 4. (1) Gahunda y’inama y’ubuyobozi
igenwa n’inama y’ubutegetsi, habayeho
ukwemeranya kw’ubwiganze
bw’abanyamuryango b’Umuryango mu gihe
cy’inama y’ubutegetsi mpuzamahanga,
cyangwa ukwemeranya ku bwiganze
bw’abanyamuryango bo mu karere bireba mu
gihe ari inama y’ubutegetsi y’akarere,
hagendewe ku biteganywa mu ngingo ya 76.
57. (2) Iyi gahunda ikubiyemo ikibazo icyo ari
cyo cyose Inama y’abahawe ububasha
bahagarariye ibuhugu yagennye ko gishyirwa
ku murongo w'ibyigwa.
58. (3) Ibintu bikurikira bishobora kandi
gushyirwa kuri gahunda y’ibyigwa by’inama
y’ubutegetsi ku isi yiga ku bijyanye
n’itumanaho rya radiyo :
(a) amatora y’abagize Ikigo Mpuzamahanga
gishinzwe kwandika imiyoboro y’itumanaho,
hakurikijwe ingingo ya 172 kugeza kuri 174;
59. (b) amabwiriza kuri urwo rwego yerekeye
ibikorwa byayo no gusuzuma ibyo bikorwa.
60. 5. (1) Hatumizwa inama y’ubutegetsi ku isi
yose:
(a) ku cyemezo cy'Inama y’abahawe ububasha
bahagarariye ibihugu ishobora kugena umunsi
n'aho inama izabera;
61. (b) bisabwe n'inama y'ubutegetsi yo ku
rwego rw’isi yabanje;
62. (c) bisabwe nibura na kimwe cya kane
cy’abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije b’Umuryango,
bazajya bageza ubusabe ku giti cyabo ku
Munyamabanga Mukuru; cyangwa
63. (d) bisabwe n'Inama y'Ubutegetsi.
64. (2) Mu bihe bivugwa mu nomero ya 61, iya
62 na 63, kandi iyo bibaye ngombwa, mu gihe
kivugwa mu nomero ya 60, itariki n’ahazabera
inama bigenwa n’Inama y’ubutegetsi ku
bwumvikane bw’ibihugu byinshi
bw’Abanyamuryango b’Umuryango,
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa mu nomero ya 76.
65. 6. (1) Inama y’ubutegetsi y’akarere
itumizwa:
(a) ku mpamvu z'icyemezo cy'Inama
y’abahawe ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu;
66. (b) ku mpamvu z’icyemezo cyatanzwe
n'inama y'ubutegetsi ku rwego rw’isi cyangwa
urw’akarere iheruka ;
67. (c) bisabwe nibura na kimwe cya kane
cy’abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije b’akarere
bakomoka mu karere bireba, buri wese muri bo
yohereza ubusabe bwe ku giti cye ku
Munyamabanga Mukuru ; cyangwa
68. (d) ku busabe bw'Inama y'Ubutegetsi.
69. (2) Mu bihe bivugwa muri nomero ya 66,
iya 67 n’iya 68, kandi iyo bibaye ngombwa, no
mu gihe kivugwa muri nomero ya 65, itariki
n’ahazabera inama bigenwa n’Inama
y’ubutegetsi ku bwumvikane bw’ubwiganze
bw’Abanyamuryango b’Umuryango bakomoka
mu karere bireba, hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
muri nomero ya 76.
70. 7. (1) Gahunda, cyangwa itariki cyangwa
aho inama y’ubutegetsi ibera ishobora
guhinduka:
(a) bisabwe nibura na kimwe cya kane
cy’abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije b’Umuryango,
mu gihe habaye inama y’ubutegetsi ku rwego
rw’isi, cyangwa byibuze kimwe cya kane
cy’abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije bakomoka mu
karere bireba mu gihe habaye inama
y’ubutegetsi mu karere. Ubusabe bwabo
bushyikirizwa, buri munyamuryango ku giti
cye, Umunyamabanga Mukuru na we
akabushyikiriza Inama y’ubutegetsi kugira ngo
ibwemeze ; cyangwa
71. (b) ku busabe bw'Inama y'Ubutegetsi.
72. (2) Mu bihe bivugwa muri nomero ya 70
n’iya 71, impinduka zatanzwe ntizemezwa
burundu keretse zemejwe n’ubwiganze
bw’abanyamuryango b’Umuryango, mu gihe
ari inama mpuzamahanga y’ubutegetsi,
cyangwa n’ubwiganze bw’Abanyamuryango
bakomoka mu karere bireba, mu gihe ari inama
y’ubutegetsi yo ku rwego rw’akarere,
haseguriwe ibiteganywa mu nomero ya 76.
73. 8. (1) Inama y ‘Ubutegetsi ishobora gusanga
ari ngombwa ko inteko nyamukuru y’inama
y’ubutegetsi ibanzirizwa n’inama itegura
hagamijwe gutegura ibyifuzo bijyanye
n’ishingiro rya tekiniki ry’imirimo y’iyo nama.
74. (2) Gutumiza inama nk’iyi yo kwitegura na
gahunda yayo bigomba kwemezwa
n’ubwiganze bw’abanyamuryango
b’Umuryango mu gihe habaye inama
y’ubutegetsi yo ku rwego rw’isi, cyangwa
n’ubwiganze bw’abanyamuryango
b’Umuryango baturuka mu karere bireba mu
gihe cy’inama y’ubutegetsi yo ku rwego
rw’akarere, hashingiwe ku biteganywa muri
nomero ya 76.
75. (3) Uretse iyo Inama itegura inama
y’ubutegetsi ibyemeje ukundi, inyandiko
zemejwe burundu n’iyo nama zikusanyirizwa
mu cyegeranyo kizemezwa kandi
kigashyirwaho umukono n’Umuyobozi wayo.
76. 9. Mu gihe hari gahunda yo kugisha inama
zivugwa muri nomero ya 56, 64, 69, 72 na 74,
Abanyamuryango b’Umuryango batigeze
basubiza mu gihe cyagenwe n’Inama
y’ubutegetsi bafatwa nk’abataragize uruhare
muri izo gahunda zo kugisha inama, ku bw’ibyo
ntibazarebwaho mu gihe cyo kubara
ubwiganze. Iyo umubare w’abatanze ibisubizo
utarenze kimwe cya kabiri
cy’Abanyamuryango bagishijwe inama,
hakorwa indi gahunda yo kugisha inama.

articles.heading: Amategeko ngengamikorere y’Inama n’Inteko 77. Mu gutegura akazi kazo no mu miyoborere y’ibiganiro byazo, inama n’inteko zikurikiza
articles.text:
Amategeko ngengamikorere ari mu Mategeko
Rusange agize Umugereka w’Amasezerano.
Icyakora, buri nama cyangwa inteko ishobora
kwemeza andi mategeko ngengamikorere
asobanura birambuye ibiteganyijwe mu mutwe
wa 9 w’Amategeko Rusange, iyo ibona ko ari
ngombwa cyane, igihe cyose ayo mategeko
ngengamikorere y’inyongera ajyana
n’Amasezerano ndetse n’Amategeko Rusange.

articles.heading: Inama y'Ubutegetsi A. Imitunganyirize n'imikorere 78. 1. (1) Inama y’ubutegetsi igizwe n’abanyamuryango makumyabiri n’icyenda
articles.text:
b’Umuryango batorwa n’Inama y’abahawe
ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu, hitawe ku
ihame ryo guhagararira mu buryo bungana
ibice byose by’isi. Abanyamuryango
b’Umuryango batorwa mu Nama baguma mu
myanya kugeza ku itariki Inama y’abahawe
ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu itoreye Inama
nshya. Abo banyamuryango bemerewe kongera
kwiyamamaza no gutorwa.
79. (2) Iyo hagati y’Inama ebyiri z’abahawe
ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu habayeho
icyuho ku mwanya w’Inama y’Ubutegetsi, uwo
mwanya uhabwa ku buryo bwemewe
n’amategeko umunyamuryango w’Umuryango
uva mu karere kamwe n’uwari uwurimo, wari
wabonye amajwi menshi kurusha abandi
batatowe mu matora aheruka.
80. (3) Umwanya w’Inama y’Ubutegetsi
ufatwa nk’urimo icyuho:
(a) iyo umwe mu bagize Inama adafite
umuhagarariye mu nama ebyiri zikurikirana
z’Inama y’Ubutegetsi ziba buri mwaka ;
81. (b) iyo Umunyamuryango w’Umuryango
yeguye ku mwanya w’ubunyamuryango afite
mu Nama.
82. 2 Iyo bishoboka, buri Munyamuryango
w’Inama ashyiraho umuntu ugomba
kumuhagararira mu Nama, akaba ari umukozi
ukorera cyangwa ushinzwe mu buryo
butaziguye inzego z’ubuyobozi bw’itumanaho
mu gihugu cye, kandi ufite ubumenyi
n’ubushobozi mu bijyanye na serivisi
z’itumanaho.
83. 3. Buri Munyamuryango w’Inama
y’Ubutegetsi agira ijwi rimwe mu itora.
84. 4. Inama y’ubutegetsi ishyiraho amategeko
ngengamikorere yayo.
55. Inama y’Ubutegetsi itora Perezida wayo
n’Umwungirije mu ntangiriro z’inama yayo ya
buri mwaka. Bakora inshingano kugeza habaye
indi nama yayo y’umwaka ukurikira, kandi
bemerewe kongera gutorwa. Visi perezida
akora nka Perezida mu igihe Perezida adahari.
86. 6. (1). Inama y’Ubutegetsi igomba guterana
rimwe mu mwaka ku cyicaro cy’Umuryango.
87. (2) Mu gihe cy’iyo nteko ya buri mwaka,
Inama y’Ubutegetsi ishobora gufata icyemezo
cyo gukora by’umwihariko indi nteko.
88. (3) Hagati y’inteko zisanzwe, Inama
y’Ubutegetsi ishobora gutumizwa, nk’uko
bisanzwe, ku cyicaro cy’Umuryango, na
Perezida wayo ku busabe bw’ubwiganze
bw’abanyamuryango.
89. 7. Umunyamabanga Mukuru
n’Umwungirije, Perezida na Visi Perezida
w’Ikigo Mpuzamahanga gishinzwe kwandika
Imirongo y’Itumanaho, ndetse n’Abayobozi ba
Komite Mpuzamahanga Ngishwanama
bashobora, ku buryo bwemewe n’amategeko,
kwitabira ibiganiro by’Inama y’Ubutegetsi,
ariko batagira uruhare mu gutora. Icyakora,
Inama ishobora gufata icyemezo cyo gukora
inama zitabirwa gusa n’abanyamuryango bayo
gusa.
90. 8. Umunyamabanga Mukuru akora imirimo
nk’Umunyamabanga w’Inama y’Ubutegetsi.
91. 9. (1) Mu gihe kiri hagati y’Inama
y’abahawe ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu,
Inama y’Ubutegetsi ikora mu izina ry’Inama
y’abahawe ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu,
ariko mu mbibi z’ububasha yahawe na yo.
92. (2) Inama ikora gusa mu gihe iri mu nteko
zemewe.
93. 10. Uhagarariye buri munyamuryango
w’Inama y’Ubutegetsi afite uburenganzira bwo
kwitabira, nk’indorerezi, inama zose z’inzego
zihoraho z’Umuryango zivugwa mu numero za
30, 31, na 32.
94. 11. Amafaranga ajyanye n’urugendo n’ayo
kubaho byakoreshejwe n’uhagarariye buri
munyamuryango w’Inama y’Ubutegetsi, mu
bijyanye n’inteko z’Inama z’ubutegetsi ni yo
yonyine yishyurwa n’Umuryango.
B. Inshingano
95. 12. (1) Inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe gufata
ingamba zose zikenewe kugira ngo ifashe
abanyamuryango shingiro n’abanyamuryango
bungirije ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’ibikubiye
muri aya Masezerano, mu mategeko, ibyemezo
by’Inama y’abahawe ububasha bahagarariye
ibihugu, ndetse iyo bibaye ngombwa,
n’ibyemezo by’izindi nama z’Umuryango.
96. (2) Iharanira gushyiraho uburyo bunoze
bwo guhuza ibikorwa by’Umuryango.
97. 13. By'umwihariko, Inama y'Ubutegetsi
igomba:
(a) gukora inshingano izo ari zo zose ihabwa
n’Inama y’abahawe ububasha bahagarariye
ibihugu;
98. (b) mu gihe kiri hagati y’Inama y’abahawe
ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu, iba ishinzwe
ko habaho guhuza ibikorwa n’imiryango
mpuzamahanga ivugwa mu ngingo ya 29 n’iya
30, kandi, ku bw’ibyo, igirana, mu izina
ry’Umuryango, amasezerano y’agateganyo
n’imiryango mpuzamahanga ivugwa mu
ngingo ya 30, n’Umuryango w’Abibumbye mu
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’Amasezerano hagati
y’Umuryango w’Abibumbye n’Umuryango
Mpuzamahanga w’Itumanaho; ayo masezerano
y’agateganyo yohererezwa Inama y’abahawe
ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu ikurikira
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa muri numero ya 42 ;
99. (c) gufata umwanzuro ku bijjyanye
n’umubare n’icyiciro cy’imyanya y’abakozi
b’Ubunyamabanga Bukuru n’udushami
twabwo twihariye tw’inzego zihoraho
z’Umuryango, hashingiwe ku mabwiriza
rusange yatanzwe n’Inama y’abahawe
ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu;
100. (d) gutegura amategeko ibona ko akenewe
mu bikorwa by’ubutegetsi n’iby’imari
by’Umuryango; n’amategeko agenga
ubutegetsi agendanye n’imikorere isanzwe
ikoreshwa n’Umuryango w’Abibumbye
n’amashami yawo yihariye bikoresha uburyo
rusange mu kwishyura, indamunite
n’ibigenerwa abari mu zabukuru;
101. (e) kugenzura imikorere y’ubutegetsi
bw’Umuryango ;
102. (f) gusuzuma no kwemeza ingengo y’imari
ya buri mwaka y’Umuryango, gukora
ibishoboka byose mu gucunga neza umutungo;
(103) (g) gutunganya igenzura ry’ibaruramari
rya buri mwaka kuri konti z’Umuryango
ritegurwa n’Umunyamabanga Mukuru kandi
ikaryemeza kugira ngo rishyikirizwe Inama
y’abahawe ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu
ikurikira;
104. (h) kunoza aho ari ngombwa :
1. ibyiciro by’imishahara fatizo ku bakozi bo
mu byiciro by’abanyamwuga n’abo mu byiciro
byisumbuyeho, havuyemo imishahara y’abo
mu myanya itorerwa, hagamijwe guhuza
n’ihinduka iryo ari ryo ryose mu mishahara
fatizo yemejwe n’Umuryango w’Abibumbye
ku byiciro bijyanye n’ibyiciro rusange;
2. ibyiciro by’imishahara fatizo ku bakozi bo
mu byiciro by’imirimo rusange kubihuza
n’ihinduka ry’ibyiciro by’imishahara
bikurikizwa n’Umuryango w’Abibumbye
n’amashami yawo yihariye ku cyicaro
cy’Umuryango ;
3. amafaranga agenerwa abakozi bo mu cyiciro
cy’akazi k’umwuga n’abo mu cyiciro
cyisumbuye, harimo imyanya itorerwa,
hakurikijwe ibyemezo by’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye kugira ngo byubahirizwe ku
cyicaro cy’Umuryango;
4. amafaranga agenerwa abakozi bose
b’Umuryango, ajyanye n’impinduka izo ari zo
zose zemejwe muri gahunda rusange
y’Umuryango w’Abibumbye;
5. imisanzu itangwa n'Umuryango hamwe
n'abakozi bawo mu Kigega cya pansiyo
y’abakozi b’Umuryango w’Abibumbye
hakurikijwe ibyemezo by’Icyo Kigega;
6. amafaranga yo kubaho ahabwa
abagenerwabikorwa b’Ikigega cya pansiyo
kandi gishinzwe gufasha mu bihe bidasanzwe
hashingiwe ku migirire y’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye.
(i) gutegura ibikenerwa ngo hatumizwe inama
y’abahawe ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu
n’Inama y’ubutegetsi y’Umuryango
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya 6 n’iya
7;
(j) guha Inama y’abahawe ububasha
bahagarariye ibihugu y’Umuryango ibitekerezo
ibona ko ari ingirakamaro ;
(k) guhuza ibikorwa by'inzego zihoraho
z'Umuryango, gufata ingamba ziboneye ku
busabe cyangwa ibyifuzonama byatanzwe
n’izo nzego, no gukora isuzuma rya raporo zazo
za buri mwaka;
(l) iyo ibona ko ari ngombwa, iteganya uburyo
bwo gushyiraho by’agateganyo
Umunyamabanga Mukuru wungirije ;
(m) guteganya uburyo bw’agateganyo bwo
gushyira mu myanya abayobozi ba Komite
Ngishwanama Mpuzamahanga;
(n) gukora indi mirimo iteganywa muri aya
Masezerano mpuzamahanga, kandi, mu rwego
rw'ibikubiye mu Masezerano mpuzamahanga
ndetse no mu mabwiriza, imikorere iyo ari yo
yose ibona ko ari ngombwa ku mikorere myiza
y’Umuryango;
(o) gufata ingamba zikenewe, ku bwumvikane
bw’ubwiganze bw’abanyamuryango
b’Umuryango, kugira ngo ikemure
by’agateganyo ibibazo bitarebwa
n’Amasezerano n’imigereka yayo kandi
bidashobora gutegereza inama ibifitiye
ububasha y’ubutaha kugira ngo bikemuke ;
(p) gutanga raporo y'ibikorwa byayo
n'iby'umuryango kugira ngo bisuzumwe
n'inama y’abahawe ububasha bahagarariye
ibihugu ;
(q) koherereza abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije b’Umuryango,
vuba bishoboka nyuma ya buri nama, incamake
za raporo z'ibikorwa by'Inama y'Ubutegetsi
n'izindi nyandiko zose ibona ko ari ngombwa;
119. (r) guteza imbere ubufatanye
mpuzamahanga mu rwego rwo gutanga
ubufatanye mu bya tekinike mu bihugu
bigishingwa cyangwa biri mu nzira
y'amajyambere mu buryo bwose bushoboka,
cyane cyane binyuze mu ruhare rw’Umuryango
muri gahunda ziboneye z’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye; kandi, hakurikijwe intego
z’Umuryango, guteza imbere mu buryo bwose
bushoboka, iterambere ry’itumanaho.

articles.heading: Ubunyamabanga Bukuru 120. 1. (1) Ubunyamabanga Bukuru buyoborwa n'Umunyamabanga Mukuru, afashijwe n'Umunyamabanga Mukuru
articles.text:
wungirije.
121. (2) Umunyamabanga Mukuru
n'Umunyamabanga Mukuru wungirije
batangira imirimo yabo ku matariki yagenwe
igihe batorewe. Ubusanzwe, bakomeza imirimo
yabo kugeza ku matariki agenwa n'inama
y’abahawe ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu,
kandi bashobora kongera gutorwa.
122. (3) Umunyamabanga Mukuru akuriwe mu
kazi n’Inama y'Ubutegetsi mu bikorwa byose
by’Umuryango birebana n’imiyoborere
n’imari.Umunyamabanga Mukuru wungirije
akuriwe mu kazi n’Umunyamabanga Mukuru.
123. (4) Iyo umwanya w’Umunyamabanga
Mukuru utakirimo ugomba kuwukoramo,
Umunyamabanga Mukuru wungirije akora
inshingano ze by’agateganyo.
124 2. Umunyamabanga Mukuru:
(a) ahuza ibikorwa by’inzego zihoraho
z’Umuryango abifashijwemo na Komite
mpuzabikorwa iteganywa mu ngingo ya 11;
125. (b) ategura imirimo y’Ubunyamabanga
Bukuru kandi agashyiraho abakozi bakoramo,
akurikije amabwiriza yatanzwe n’Inama
y’abahawe ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu
n’amategeko yashyizweho n’Inama
y’Ubutegetsi;
126. (c) afata ibyemezo by’ubuyobozi
by’ubunyamabanga bwihariye bw’inzego
zihoraho z’Umuryango no gushyiraho abakozi
b’ubwo bunyamabanga byumvikanweho
n’Umuyobozi wa buri rwego ruhoraho;
ishyirwaho rikorwa hashingiwe ku guhitamo
kwe, ariko icyemezo cya nyuma cyo
gushyiraho cyangwa kwirukana gifatwa
n’Umunyamabanga Mukuru;
127. (d) atanga raporo ku Nama y'ubutegetsi
y’ibyemezo byose byafashwe n'Umuryango
w'Abibumbye n'amashami yawo yihariye
bigira ingaruka ku mikorere rusange ya serivisi,
indamunite na pansiyo;
128. (e) akurikina ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ry’amabwiriza y’imari n’ay’ubutegetsi
yemejwe n’Inama y’Ubutegetsi;
129. (f) agenzura, hagamijwe gusa impamvu
z’ubutegetsi, abakozi b’ubwo bunyamabanga
bwihariye bakora mu buryo butaziguye
bahabwa amabwiriza n’abayobozi b’inzego
zihoraho z’Umuryango;
130. (g) akora imirimo y’Ubunyamabanga
ikorwa mbere na nyuma y’inama
z’Umuryango;
131. (h) ashyiraho, iyo ari ngombwa, ku
bufatanye na Guverinoma itumira,
Ubunyamabanga bwa buri nama y’Umuryango,
kandi, atanga ibikoresho na serivisi bikenewe
mu nama z’inzego zihoraho z’Umuryango ku
bufatanye n’abayobozi bazo. Umunyamabanga
Mukuru ashobora kandi, iyo abisabwe,
gushyiraho Ubunyamabanga bw’izindi nama
z’itumanaho hashingiwe ku masezerano ;
132. (i) kuvugurura inyito zemejwe hashingiwe
ku makuru yatanzwe hashingiwe ku makuru
atangwa n’inzego zihoraho z’Umuryango
cyangwa z’ubutegetsi, uretse inyandiko
ngenderwaho n’izindi nyandiko z’ingenzi
zifitanye isano n’inshingano z’Ikigo
Mpuzamahanga gishinzwe kwandika imirongo
y’itumanaho;
133. (j) atangaza ibyifuzonama na raporo
z’ingenzi z’inzego zihoraho z’Umuryango ;
134. (k) atangaza amasezerano mpuzamahanga
n’ay’akarere yerekeranye n’itumanaho
yamenyeshejwe n’abayagiranye, no guhuza
n’igihe inyandiko z’ayo masezerano;
135. (l) atangaza amabwiriza ya tekiniki y’Ikigo
Mpuzamahanga gishinzwe kwandika
imirongo y’itumanaho, kimwe n’andi makuru
ajyanye n’ishyirwaho no gukoresha imirongo
y’itumanaho, yakozwe n’Ikigo mu rwego rwo
kuzuza inshingano zacyo.
136. (m) ategura, atangaza kandi ajyanisha
n’igihe abifashijwemo, aho bikwiye, n’izindi
nzego zihoraho z’Umuryango:
137. 1. inyandiko igaragaza ibigize
Umuryango n'imiterere yawo ;
138. 2. ibarurishamibare rusange n’inyandiko
za serivisi zemewe z’Umuryango nk’uko
biteganywa n’amabwiriza ari ku mugereka w’
Amasezerano mpuzamahanga;
139. 3. izindi nyandiko Inama cyangwa Inama
y’ubutegetsi ishobora gutegeka;
140. (n) atanga inyandiko zatangajwe ku
mugaragaro;
141. (o) akusanya akanatangaza, mu buryo
bukwiye, haba ku rwego rw’igihugu ndetse no
ku rwego mpuzamahanga, amakuru, yerekeye
itumanaho ku isi hose;
142. (p) akusanya kandi agatangaza, ku
bufatanye n’izindi nzego zihoraho
z’Umuryango, amakuru ajyanye na tekiniki
n’ubuyobozi ashobora
gukenerwa n’ibihugu bigishingwa cyangwa
bikiri mu nzira y’amajyambere kugira ngo
abifashe gutuma imiyoboro y’itumanaho yabyo
ikora neza. Ibyo
bihugu bizagaragarizwa kandi amahirwe
atangwa n’imishinga mpuzamahanga
ishyigikiwe n’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ;
143. (q) akusanya akanatangaza amakuru
ashobora gufasha abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije ibyerekeye
uburyo bw’iterambere ry’ uburyo bwa tekiniki
hagamijwe kugera ku mikorere inoze ya serivisi
z’itumanaho kandi cyane cyane gukoresha neza
bishoboka imirongo ya radiyo kugira ngo
bigabanye kwivanga;
144. (r) atangaza buri gihe, akoresheje amakuru
yahawe cyangwa ashobora kuba yarakusanyije,
harimo ayo
ashobora gukura mu yindi miryango
mpuzamahanga, ikinyamakuru gitangaza
amakuru n’inyandiko rusange n’ibijyanye
n’itumanaho ;
145. (s) ategura akanashyikiriza Inama
y’Ubutegetsi ingengo y’imari y’umwaka,
nyuma yo kwemezwa n’Inama, igashyikirizwa
abanyamuryango shingiro n’abanyamuryango
bungirije kugira ngo bayigireho amakuru;
146. (t) ategura raporo y’imicungire y’imari
igomba koherezwa buri mwaka mu Nama
y’ubutegetsi na raporo y’ibaruramari rusange
risobanura ishusho y’ibyakoreshejwe mbere ya
buri Nama ; iryo baruramari, nyuma y’igenzura
no kwemezwa n’inama y’ubutegetsi,
zizashyikirizwa abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije ndetse
zigashyikirizwa Inama y’abahawe ububasha
bahagarariye ibihugu ngo zisuzumwe kandi
zemezwe burundu;
147. (u) gutegura raporo y’umwaka ku bikorwa
by’Umuryango, nyuma yo kwemezwa n’Inama
y’ubutegetsi, igashyikirizwa Abanyamuryango
shingiro n’abanyamuryango bungirije bose;
148. (v) gukora indi mirimo yose
y’ubunyamabanga bw’Umuryango ;
149. (w) gukora nk'uhagarariye mu mategeko
Umuryango.
150 3. Umunyamabanga Mukuru wungirije
afasha Umunyamabanga Mukuru gukora
inshingano ze no gukora imirimo yihariye
ashobora guhabwa n’Umunyamabanga
Mukuru. Akora imirimo y’Umunyamabanga
Mukuru mu gihe adahari.
151. 4. Umunyamabanga Mukuru cyangwa
Umunyamabanga Mukuru wungirije bashobora
kwitabira, mu rwego rwo kugisha inama, mu
Nteko rusange za Komite Ngishwanama
mpuzamahanga no mu nama zose
z’Umuryango; Umunyamabanga Mukuru
cyangwa umuhagarariye bashobora, mu rwego
rwo gutanga inama, kwitabira izindi nama zose
z’Umuryango; uruhare rwabo mu nama z'Inama
y'Ubutegetsi rugengwa n’ibikubiye muri
nomero ya 89.

articles.heading: Komite mpuzabikorwa 152. 1. (1) Umunyamabanga Mukuru afashwa na Komite ishinzwe guhuza ibikorwa izajya
articles.text:
imugira inama ku bibazo bijyanye
n’ubuyobozi, imari n’ubufatanye bwa tekiniki
bireba inzego nyinshi zihoraho, ndetse
n’ibirebana n’imikoranire mpuzamahanga
n’itangwa ry’amakuru ku baturage.
153. (2) Komite isuzuma kandi ibibazo
by'ingenzi yohererejwe n'Inama y'Ubutegetsi.
Komite imaze kubisuzuma, iha raporo Inama,
ibinyujije ku Munyamabanga Mukuru.
154. (3) Komite, by’umwihariko, ifasha cyane
cyane Umunyamabanga Mukuru mu nshingano
yahawe hakurikijwe ibiteganywa muri nomero
144, iya 145, iya 146 n’iya 147.
155. (4) Komite isuzuma aho imirimo
y’Umuryango igeze mu bufatanye bwa tekinike
kandi itanga inama, binyuze ku
Munyamabanga Mukuru, mu Nama
y’Ubutegetsi.
156. (5) Komite ishinzwe guhuza ibikorwa
n’imiryango mpuzamahanga yose ivugwa mu
ngingo ya 29 n'iya 30 ku bijyanye no
guhagararira inzego zihoraho z’Umuryango mu
nama z’iyo miryango.
157. 2. Komite yihatira gufata imyanzuro
yemejwe na bose. Umunyamabanga Mukuru,
ariko, ashobora gufata ibyemezo kabone n’iyo
yaba adashyigikiwe n’abandi babiri cyangwa
benshi mu bagize Komite, mu gihe abona ko
ibyo bibazo byihutirwa. Muri ibyo bihe, iyo
abisabwe na Komite, aha raporo Inama
y’ubutegetsi kuri ibyo bibazo, byemejwe
n'abagize Komite bose. Iyo, mu bihe nk'ibyo,
ibibazo bitihutirwa ariko ari ngombwa,
byoherezwa gusuzumwa mu nama itaha
y'Inama y'Ubutegetsi.
158. 3. Komite iyoborwa n’Umunyamabanga
Mukuru kandi igizwe n’Umunyamabanga
Mukuru wungirije, Abayobozi ba Komite
Ngishwanama Mpuzamahanga na Perezida
w’Ikigo mpuzamahanga gishinzwe kwandika
imirongo y’itumanaho.
159. 4. Komite iterana iyo itumijwe na Perezida
wayo, kandi muri rusange, iterana nibura rimwe
mu kwezi.

articles.heading: Abayobozi batowe n'abakozi b'Umuryango 160. 1. Umunyamabanga Mukuru, Umunyamabanga Mukuru wungirije
articles.text:
n’abayobozi ba Komite Mpuzamahanga
Ngishwanama bose ni abenegihugu b’ibihugu
bitandukanye, Abanyamuryango
b’Umuryango. Mu matora yabo, hakwiye
kwitabwaho amahame akubiye muri nomero ya
164 no guhagararirwa gukwiriye k’uturere
tw’isi.
161. 2. (1) Mu gihe bakora inshingano zabo,
yaba abayobozi batowe n’abakozi
b’Umuryango ntibagomba gusaba cyangwa
ngo bemere amabwiriza atanzwe n’igihugu
icyo ari cyo cyose cyangwa n’urundi rwego
urwo ari rwo rwose rutari urw’Umuryango.
Bagomba kwirinda imyitwarire iyo ari yo yose
ishobora kuba inyuranyije n’urwego rwabo
nk’abakozi mpuzamahanga.
162. (2) Buri Munyamuryango shingiro
n’Umunyamuryango wungirije agomba
kubaha imiterere mpuzamahanga yihariye
y’inshingano z’abayobozi batowe n’abakozi
b’Umuryango, kandi akirinda kubashyiraho
igitutu igihe bakora akazi kabo.
163. (3) Nta muyobozi watowe cyangwa undi
mukozi uwo ari we wese w’Umuryango
wemerewe kugira uruhare urwo ari rwo rwose
cyangwa inyungu zishingiye ku mafaranga mu
kigo icyo ari cyo cyose gifite aho gihuriye
n’itumanaho, keretse iyo biri mu nshingano ze
z’akazi. Icyakora, ijambo “inyungu zishingiye
ku mafaranga” ntirikwiye gusobanurwa
nk’iribuza gukomeza kubona amafaranga
y’izabukuru aturuka ku kazi yakoze mbere.
164. 3. Icy’ingenzi kigomba kwitabwaho mu
gushaka abakozi no mu kugena imiterere
y’akazi kabo bigomba kuba ari ingenzi ko
Umuryango ubona serivisi zitangwa n’abantu
bafite inararibonye yo ku rwego rwo hejuru mu
mikorere, ubushobozi n’ubunyangamugayo.
Akamaro ko gushaka abakozi baturuka mu
turere dutandukanye tw’isi uko bishoboka kose
bigomba kwitabwaho uko bikwiye.

articles.heading: Ikigo mpuzamahanga gishinzwe kwandika imirongo y’itumanaho 165. 1. Inshingano z’ingenzi z'Ikigo
articles.text:
mpuzamahanga gishinzwe kwandika imirongo
y’itumanaho ni izi zikurikira:
(a) gushyira mu bikorwa uburyo butunganye
bwo kwandika imikoreshereze y’imirongo
y’itumanaho bikozwe n’ibihugu bitandukanye,
hagamijwe gushyiraho, hakurikijwe uburyo
buteganywa n’Amategeko agenga Itumanaho
rya Radiyo kandi hashingiwe ku byemezo ibyo
ari byo byose bishobora gufatwa n’inama
zibifitiye ububasha z’Umuryango, itariki,
intego, n’imiterere ya tekiniki by’iyo
mikoreshereze y’imirongo, hagamijwe ko
ihabwa agaciro ku rwego mpuzamahanga ;
166. (b) guha inama abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije hagamijwe
ikoreshwa ry’umubare munini w’imiyoboro ya
radiyo ishoboka yose, mu gice
cy’impuzamirongo aho kwivanga kw’imirongo
kwangiza cyane itumanaho gushobora kubaho ;
167. (c) gukora imirimo iyo ari yo yose
y'inyongera, ijyanye no gutanga no gukoresha
imirongo y’itumanaho, igenwa n'inama
ibifitiye ububasha y'Umuryango, cyangwa
n'Inama y'Ubutegetsi byemejwe n’ubwiganze
bw’abanyamuryango, mu rwego rwo gutegura
cyangwa gushyira mu bikorwa ibyemezo by'iyo
nama;
168. (d) kubika inyandiko z’ingenzi zishobora
kuba zijyanye no gukora inshingano zacyo.
169. 2. (1) Ikigo mpuzamahanga gishinzwe
kwandika imirongo y’itumanaho kigizwe
n’abanyamuryango batanu bigenga bagenwe
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa muri nomero 172
kugeza ku ya 180.
170. (2) Abagize Inama y'Ubutegetsi bagomba
kuba bafite ubumenyi buhagije mu bijyanye
n’amahugurwa ya tekiniki mu bijyanye na
radiyo kandi bafite uburambe bufatika mu
kugena no gukoresha imirongo y’itumanaho.
171. (3) Byongeye kandi, kugira ngo
basobanukirwe neza ibibazo bizashyikirizwa
Inama y’Ubutegetsi hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
muri nomero ya 166, buri munyamuryango
agomba kuba azi imiterere y’akarere runaka ku
isi, harimo ibijyanye n’ubutaka, ubukungu
n’imibereho y’abahatuye.
172. 3. (1) Abagize Inama y’Ubutegetsi batanu
bazajya batorerwa manda y’igihe kitarengeje
imyaka itanu, mu nama mpuzamahanga
y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe ibijyanye n’itumanaho
rya radiyo. Abo bagize Inama batoranywa mu
bakandida bashyigikiwe n’ibihugu bigize
Umuryango. Buri gihugu kigize Umuryango
gishobora gutanga umukandida umwe, kandi
uwo mukandida agomba kuba ari
umwenegihugu w’icyo gihugu. Buri
mukandida agomba kugira ubushobozi
buvugwa muri nomero ya 170 n’iya 171.
173. (2) Uburyo aya matora akorwamo
buzashyirwaho n’inama ubwayo ku buryo
uduce dutandukanye tw’isi duhagararirwa ku
buryo bungana.
174. (3) Muri buri matora, buri
munyamuryango uri kurangiza manda ye mu
Nama y’Ubutegetsi ashobora kongera
gutangwa nk’umukandida n’igihugu
akomokamo.
175. (4) Abagize Inama y’Ubutegetsi batangira
inshingano zabo ku itariki yagenwe n’inama
mpuzamahanga yabatoye. Bakomeza gukora
kugeza ku itariki izashyirwaho n’inama izatora
abasimbura babo.
176. (5) iyo hagati y’inama ebyiri
mpuzamahanga z’ubutegetsi zitorwamo
abanyamuryango b’Inama, iyo
umunyamuryango w’Inama watowe asezeye
cyangwa aretse inshingano ze nta mpamvu
yumvikana igihe kirenze iminsi mirongo itatu,
cyangwa se agapfa, igihugu, kigize
Umuryango, uwo muntu akomokamo
gibisabwa na Perezida w’Inama gutanga undi
umusimbura vuba bishoboka, uwo na we akaba
ari umwenegihugu w’icyo gihugu.
177. (6) Iyo icyo gihugu kigize Umuryango
bireba kidatanze umusimbura mu gihe kingana
n’amezi atatu uhereye ku itariki cyabisabiweho,
gitakaza uburenganzira bwo kugena umuntu
uhagararira icyo gihugu mu Nama mu gihe
gisigaye cya manda yayo.
178. (7) Iyo hagati y’inama ebyiri
mpuzamahanga z’ubutegetsi zitorwamo
abanyamuryango b’Inama, iyo umusimbura na
we asezeye cyangwa aretse inshingano ze nta
mpamvu yumvikana mu gihe kirenze iminsi
mirongo itatu cyangwa agapfa, icyo gihugu,
kiri mu banyamuryango b’Umuryango uwo
muntu akomokamo, ntikizaba gifite
uburenganzira bwo gutanga undi musimbura.
179. (8) Mu bihe bivugwa muri nomero ya 177
n’iya 178, Perezida w’Inama asaba
Umunyamabanga Mukuru gutumira ibihugu
biri mu banyamuryango b’Umuryango,
bibarizwa mu karere bireba kugira ngo bitange
abakandida bazatorwamo umusimbura mu
nama ngarukamwaka ikurikira y’Inama
y’Ubutegetsi.
180. (9) Mu rwego rwo gusigasira imikorere
inoze y’Inama, igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose gifite
umwenegihugu watorewe kuba mu Nama
kigomba kwirinda, uko bishoboka kose,
kumuhamagaza ngo ave muri izo nshingano
hagati y’Inama mpuzamahanga ebyiri
z’ubutegetsi zitorwamo abagize Inama.
181. 4. (1) Gahunda z’imikorere y’akazi
z’Inama zisobanurwa mu Mabwiriza agenga
Radiyo.
182. (2) Abagize Inama bitoramo Perezida na
Visi-Perezida, mu gihe cy'umwaka umwe.
Nyuma yaho, Visi-Perezida asimbura
Umuyobozi buri mwaka kandi hatorwa VisiPerezida mushya.
183. (3) Inama ifashwa n'ubunyamabanga
bwihariye.
184. 5. (1) Abagize Inama, bakora nk’aho batari
abahagarariye ibihugu byabo cyangwa akarere
baturukamo, ahubwo nk'abaharanira inyungu
rusange mpuzamahanga.
185. (2) Nta munyamuryango w’Inama
ushobora gusaba cyangwa guhabwa
amabwiriza arebana n'inshingano ze na
Guverinoma cyangwa umwe mu bagize iyo
Guverinoma, cyangwa umuryango cyangwa
umuntu uwo ari we wese wa Leta cyangwa
uw'abikorera. Byongeye kandi, buri
Munyamuryango shingiro n'Umunyamuryango
wungirije agomba kubahiriza imiterere
mpuzamahanga y'Inama n'inshingano
z'abanyamuryango bayo kandi akirinda
kugerageza guha amabwiriza uwo ari we wese
mu bayigize arebana n’uko akora inshingano
ze.

articles.heading: Komite Mpuzamahanga Ngishwanama 186. 1. (1) Inshingano za Komite Mpuzamahanga Ngishwanama mu bijyanye
articles.text:
n’itumanaho rya radiyo (C.C.I.R) ni
ugusuzuma ibibazo bya tekiniki n'imikorere
bireba by'umwihariko itumanaho rya radiyo no
kubitangaho ibyifuzonama..
187. (2) Inshingano za Komite Mpuzamahanga
Ngishwanama ku bijyanye na Telegarafe na
Telefone (C.C.I.T.T) ni ugusuzuma ibibazo bya
tekiniki, iby’imikorere n’iby’ibiciro bijyanye
na telegarafe na telefone no kubitangaho
ibyifuzonama.
188. (3) Mu gukora inshingano zayo, buri
Komite Ngishwanama yita cyane ku kwiga
ibibazo no gutanga ibyifuzonama bifitanye
isano itaziguye no gushyiraho, guteza imbere
no kurushaho kunoza itumanaho mu bihugu
bigishingwa cyangwa biri mu nzira
y'amajyambere haba ku rwego rw’akarere
ndetse no ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
189. (4) Bisabwe n’ibihugu birebwa, buri
Komite Ngishwanama ishobora kandi kwiga no
gutanga inama zijyanye n’ibibazo
by’itumanaho ry’ibyo bihugu. Kwiga kuri ibyo
bibazo bigomba gukorwa hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa muri nomero ya 190.
190. 2. (1) Ibibazo buri Komite Mpuzamahanga
Ngishwanama isuzuma kandi itangaho
ibyifuzonama ni ibyo Inama y’abahawe
ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu, Inama
y’ubutegetsi, Akanama k’ubutegetsi, indi
Komite Ngishwanama cyangwa Ikigo
gishinzwe kwandika imirongo y’itumanaho
biba byayigejejeho, usibye ibyemezo
byafashwe n'Inama y’abahawe ububasha
bahagarariye ibihugu ya Komite Ngishwanama
ubwayo, cyangwa, hagati y'inteko rusange
zayo, iyo bisabwe cyangwa byemejwe, binyuze
mu butumwa bwanditse, n'abanyamuryango
shingiro n’abanyamuryango bungirije
b’Umuryango nibura makumyabiri.
191. (2) Inteko rusange za Komite
Mpuzamahanga Ngishwanama zifite ububasha
bwo kugeza ku nama z'ubutegetsi ibitekerezo
bikomoka mu buryo butaziguye ku nama zazo
cyangwa komite cyangwa ku myanzuro
y'ibibazo birimo gusuzumwa n'izo komite.
192. 3. Komite Mpuzamahanga Ngishwanama
zigizwe n’abanyamuryango bakurikira:
(a) ku bw’amategeko, ubuyobozi
bw’abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije bose;
193. (b) ikigo icyo ari cyo cyose kigenga
cyemewe gikora ibikorwa by’itumanaho,
byemejwe n’Umunyamuryango shingiro
cyangwa umunyamuryango wungirije wemera
imikorere yacyo, kigaragaza ubushake bwo
kugira uruhare mu kazi k’izo Komite.
194. 4. Buri Komite Ngishwanama ikora
binyuze mu:
(a) Inteko rusange, isanzwe iterana buri myaka
itatu. Iyo hateranye inama y’ubutegetsi ku isi,
Inteko rusange igomba guterana, iyo
bishoboka, nibura amezi umunani mbere y’iyi
nama;
195. (b) amatsinda y’ubushakashatsi,
azashyirwaho n'Inteko rusange kugira ngo
akurikirane ibibazo bigomba gusuzumwa;
196. (c) umuyobozi utorwa n’Inteko Rusange
ku nshuro ya mbere, mu gihe kingana n'inshuro
ebyiri z'igihe kiri hagati y'Inteko Rusange
ebyiri zikurikirana, ubusanzwe akaba atorerwa
imyaka itandatu. Ashobora kongera gutorwa
mu Nteko Rusange ikurikiraho, kandi mu gihe
yaba yongeye gutorwa, akomeza gukora
imirimo kugeza ku itariki y'Inteko Rusange
ikurikiraho, ubusanzwe akaba amara imyaka
itatu. Iyo uwo mwanya nta muntu uwukoramo
mu buryo butunguranye, Inteko Rusange
ikurikiraho itora umuyobozi mushya;
197. (d) ubunyamabanga bwihariye, bufasha
Umuyobozi;
198. (e) laboratwari cyangwa ibikoresho bya
tekiniki byashyizweho n’Umuryango.
199. 5. Hashyirwaho Komite y'Isi ishinzwe
Igenamigambi, na za Komite z'Akarere
zishinzwe Igenamigambi zishobora kwemezwa
n'Inteko Rusange z'Inama Mpuzamahanga
Ngishwanama. Izi komite zishinzwe
igenamigambi zishyiraho igenamigambi
rusange ry'umuyoboro mpuzamahanga
w'itumanaho kugira ngo zifashe mu
igenamigambi ry'imirimo mpuzamahanga
y'itumanaho. Zishyikiriza Komite
Mpuzamahanga Ngishwanama ibibazo bifitiye
akamaro mu buryo bwihariye ibihugu
bigishingwa cyangwa biri mu nzira
y'amajyambere kandi biri mu nshingano z'izo
Komite Mpuzamahanga Ngishwanama.
200. 6. Inteko Rusange n'amatsinda ashinzwe
ubushakashatsi ya Komite Ngishwanama,
yubahiriza amategeko agenga imikorere
akubiye mu mategeko rusange ari ku mugereka
w’aya Masezerano mpuzamahanga. Bishobora
kandi gushyiraho amabwiriza y'imikorere
y'inyongera hakurikijwe nomero ya 77. Aya
mategeko y'imikorere y'inyongera atangazwa
mu nyandiko z'Inteko Rusange mu buryo
bw'umwanzuro.
201. 7. Gahunda z’imikorere ya Komite
Ngishwanama zisobanurwa mu gice cya II
cy’amabwiriza rusange ari ku mugereka w’aya
Masezerano.

articles.heading: Amabwiriza 202. 1. Hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n'ingingo ya 8, Amategeko rusange akubiye mu mugereka
articles.text:
wa 4 w'aya Masezerano mpuzamahanga afite
ububasha bungana n’aya Masezerano
mpuzamahanga n’igihe kingana n’icyayo.
203. 2. (1) Ibiteganywa n’aya Masezerano
byuzuzwa n’amategeko ajyanye n’ubutegetsi
akurikira:
Amategeko agenga telegarafe, Amategeko
agenga telefone, Amategeko agenga Radiyo,
Amategeko y’inyongera agenga Radiyo.
204. (2) Kwemeza burundu aya Masezerano
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n'ingingo ya 18
cyangwa kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano nk'uko
biteganywa n'ingingo ya 19 bisaba ko
amategeko rusange n'ay'ubutegetsi akurikizwa
mu gihe cyo kwemeza burundu cyangwa
kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye kuri
aya Masezerano.
205. (3) Abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije bamenyesha
Umunyamabanga Mukuru ko bemeje
ivugururwa iryo ari ryo ryose ry’ayo mabwiriza
bikozwe n’inama z’ubutegetsi zibifitiye
ububasha. Umunyamabanga Mukuru ahita
amenyesha abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije ibijyanye no
kwakira ayo mamenyesha y’iryo yemezwa.
206. 3. Iyo habayeho kunyuranya hagati
y’ibiteganywa n’Amasezerano mpuzamahanga
n’ibiteganywa n’amategeko, Amasezerano
mpuzamahanga ni yo akurikizwa.

articles.heading: Imari y'Umuryango 207. 1. Amafaranga akoreshwa n’Umuryango akubiyemo amafaranga akoreshwa na
articles.text:
(a) Inama y'Ubutegetsi, Ubunyamabanga
rusange, Ikigo Mpuzamahanga gishinzwe
kwandika imirongo y’itumanaho,
Ubunyamabanga bwa Komite Mpuzamahanga
Ngishwanama na Laboratwari n’ibikoresho bya
tekiniki by'Umuryango;
208. (b) Inama y’abahawe ububasha
bahagarariye ibihugu n’inama z’ubutegetsi ku
rwego mpuzamahanga;
209. (c) inama zose za Komite mpuzamahanga
Ngishwanama.
210. 2. Amafaranga akoreshwa n’inama
z’ubutegetsi zo ku rwego rw’akarere zavuzwe
muri nomero ya 50 yishyurwa
n’abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije bo ku rwego
rw’akarere bose bireba hashingiwe ku byiciro
by’imisanzu yabo, kandi iyo ari ngombwa,
yishyurwa n’abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije b’utundi turere
bitabiriye izo nama.
211. 3. Inama y’Ubutegetsi isuzuma kandi
ikemeza ingengo y’imari y’umwaka
y’Umuryango, hitawe ku rugero ntarengwa
rw’amafaranga agomba gukoreshwa
rwashyizweho n’Inama y’abahawe ububasha
bahagarariye ibihugu.
212. 4. Amafaranga akoreshwa n’Umuryango
akomoka mu misanzu y’abanyamuryango
shingiro n’abanyamuryango bungirije, buri
munyamuryango shingiro n’umunyamuryango
wungirije bishyura amafaranga ahwanye
n’umubare w’imigabane yo mu cyiciro
cy’imisanzu yahisemo hakurikijwe
imbonerahamwe ikurikira:
Icyiciro cy’imigabane 30 Icyiciro
cy’imigabane 8
’’ ’’ 25 ’’ 5
’’ ’’ 20 ’’ 4
’’ ’’ 18 ’’ 3
’’ ’’ 15 ’’ 2
’’ ’’ 13 ’’ 1
’’ ’’ 10 ½ cy’umugabane
213. 5. Abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije bafite
uburenganzira bwo guhitamo icyiciro
cy’imisanzu yo kwishyura amafaranga
akoreshwa n’Umuryango.
214. 6. (1) Nibura amezi atandatu mbere y’uko
Amasezerano atangira gukurikizwa, buri
Munyamuryango shingiro n’umunyamuryango
wungirije amenyesha Umunyamabanga
Mukuru icyiciro cy’umusanzu yahisemo.
215. (2) Umunyamabanga Mukuru amenyesha
iki cyemezo abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije.
216. (3) Abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije batabashije
gutangaza icyemezo cyabo mbere y’itariki
ivugwa muri nomero ya 214 baguma kuba mu
cyiciro cy’umusanzu bamenyesheje
Umunyamabanga Mukuru.
217. (4) Abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije bashobora igihe
icyo ari cyo cyose guhitamo icyiciro
cy’umusanzu kirenze icyo bemeje mbere.
218. (5) Nta kugabanya urwego rw’icyiciro
cy’umusanzu rwashyizweho hakurikijwe
ibikubiye muri nomero ya 214 kugeza ku ya
216 gushobora gutangira gukurikizwa mu gihe
Amasezerano agifite agaciro.
219. 7. Abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije bagomba
kwishyura mbere imigabane yabo y’umusanzu
wa buri mwaka, ibarwa hashingiwe ku ngengo
y’imari yemejwe n’Inama y’Ubutegetsi.
220. (8) (1) Buri Munyamuryango shingiro
mushya cyangwa umunyamuryango wungirije
bagomba, ku bijyanye n’umwaka wo kwemera
kuba umwe mu bahuriye kuri aya Masezerano,
gutanga umusanzu ubarwa uhereye ku munsi
wa mbere w’ukwezi yemeye kuba umwe mu
bahuriye kuri aya Masezerano.
221. (2) Iyo Umunyamuryango shingiro
cyangwa umunyamuryango wungirije yivanye
muri aya Masezerano mpuzamahanga, agomba
kwishyura umusanzu we kugeza ku munsi wa
nyuma w’ukwezi uko kwivana mu Masezerano
gutangiriraho gukurikizwa.
222. 9. Amafaranga agomba kwishyurwa
atangirwa inyungu guhera mu ntangiriro za buri
mwaka w’ingengo y’imari y’Umuryango kuri
3% (atatu ku ijana) ku mwaka mu mezi atandatu
ya mbere, no kuri 6% (atandatu ku ijana) ku
mwaka guhera mu ntangiriro z’ukwezi kwa
karindwi.
223. 10. Ingingo zikurikira zirakurikizwa ku
misanzu yatanzwe n’ibigo byigenga byemewe
bikora ibijyanye n’itumanaho, ubumenyi
cyangwa inganda n’imiryango mpuzamahanga:
224. (a) Ibigo byigenga byemewe bikora
ibikorwa by’itumanaho, hamwe n’ubumenyi
cyangwa iby’inganda bigira uruhare mu
kwishyura amafaranga akoreshwa na Komite
Mpuzamahanga byemeye kwitabira. Ibigo
byigenga byemewe bikora ibikorwa
by’itumanaho bigomba kandi kugira uruhare
mu gutanga amafaranga akoreshwa mu nama
z’ubutegetsi byemeye kwitabira cyangwa
byitabiriye, hakurikijwe ibiteganywa muri
nomero ya 621 y’Amategeko rusange.
225. (b) Imiryango mpuzamahanga na yo
igomba kugira uruhare mu kwishyura
amafaranga akoreshwa mu nama yemerewe
kwitabira, uretse igihe yahawe uburenganzira
bwo kudatanga ayo mafaranga n’Inama
y’Ubutegetsi, ku bw’impamvu magirirane;
226. (c). Ibigo byigenga byemewe bikora
ibikorwa by’itumanaho, imiryango y’ubumenyi
cyangwa iy’inganda, ndetse n’imiryango
mpuzamahanga bigira uruhare mu gutanga
amafaranga akoreshwa mu nama nk’uko
biteganywa muri nomero ya 224 n’iya 225,
bifite uburenganzira bwo kwihitiramo ku
bushake ibyiciro byo gutanga umusanzu
bikubiye muri nomero ya 212, kandi
bikamenyesha Umunyamabanga Mukuru
icyiciro cy’umusanzu byahisemo.
227. (d) Ibigo byemewe byigenga bikora
ibijyanye n’itumanaho, imiryango y’ubumenyi
n’inganda n’imiryango mpuzamahanga igira
uruhare mu kwishyura amafaranga akoreshwa
mu nama bishobora igihe icyo ari cyo cyose
guhitamo icyiciro cy’imisanzu irenze iyo
byemeje;
228. (e) Nta kugabanya umubare w’imisanzu
bikorwa mu gihe aya Masezerano
mpuzamahanga agifite agaciro;
229. (f) Mu gihe cyo kwivana mu gikorwa cyo
kwitabira ibikorwa bya Komite
Mpuzamahanga Ngishwanama, umusanzu
ugomba kwishyurwa kugeza ku munsi wa
nyuma w’ukwezi uko kwivana mu gikorwa cyo
kwitabira gutangira kugira agaciro.
230. (g) Ingano y’umusanzu ugomba
kwishyurwa n’ibigo byigenga byemewe bikora
ibikorwa by’itumanaho, imiryango
y’ubumenyi, iy’ubushakashatsi cyangwa
iy’inganda, cyangwa mpuzamahanga kugira
ngo byitabire ibikorwa bya Komite
Mpuzamahanga Ngishwanana byemeye
kwitabira, izajya igenwa buri mwaka n’Inama
y’Ubutegetsi. Iyo misanzu ifatwa nk’umutungo
w’Umuryango. Bizajya bitanga inyungu
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya 222.
231. (h) Ingano y’Umusanzu wishyurwa kuri
buri mugabane w’amafaranga akoreshwa mu
nama z’ubutegetsi utangwa n’ibigo byigenga
byemewe bikora ibikorwa by’itumanaho,
byitabiriye nk’uko biteganywa muri nomero ya
621 y’Amategeko rusange ndetse n’imiryango
mpuzamahanga yitabira, uzagenwa hashingiwe
ku kugabanya ingano y’amafaranga yose agize
ingengo y’imari y’iyo Nama umubare wose
w’imigabane yatanzwe n’Abanyamuryango
shingiro n’abanyamuryango bungirije
nk’umugabane wabo w’amafaranga akoreshwa
n’Umuryango. Iyo misanzu ifatwa
nk’umutungo w’Umuryango. Bazatanga
inyungu guhera ku munsi wa mirongo itandatu
ukurikira umunsi fagitire z’amafaranga
yakoreshejwe zatangiweho, hakurikijwe
igipimo cy’inyungu cyagenwe mu biteganyijwe
mu nomero ya 222.
232. 11. Amafaranga akoreshwa na laboratware
hamwe n’ibikoresho bya tekinike
by’Umuryango mu gupima, mu kugerageza
cyangwa mu bushakashatsi bwihariye ku
Banyamuryango shingiro ku giti cyabo
cyangwa abanyamuryango bungirije,
amatsinda y’abanyamuryango shingiro
cyangwa y’abanyamuryango bungirije,
cyangwa imiryango yo ku rwego rw’akarere
cyangwa abandi, yishyurwa n’abo
Banyamuryango shingiro cyangwa
abanyamuryango bungirije, amatsinda,
imiryango cyangwa abandi.
233. 12. Igiciro cyo kugurisha inyandiko
zigurishwa ku nzego z'ubutegetsi, ibigo
byigenga byemewe bikora ibijyanye
n’itumanaho cyangwa abantu ku giti cyabo,
kigenwa n'Umunyamabanga Mukuru,
afatanyije n'Inama y'Ubutegetsi, azirikana ko
ikiguzi cyo gucapa no gukwirakwiza
inyandiko, muri rusange, kigomba kwishyurwa
n’amafaranga avuye mu igurishwa ryazo.

articles.heading: Indimi 234. 1. (1) Indimi zemewe z’Umuryango ni Igishinwa, Icyongereza, Igifaransa, Ikirusiya
articles.text:
n’Icyesipanyolo.
235. (2) Indimi z’ akazi z'Umuryango ni
Icyongereza, Igifaransa n'Icyesipanyolo.
236. (3) Mu gihe habaye impaka, inyandiko
y’Igifaransa ni yo igira agaciro.
237. 2. (1) Inyandiko ndakuka z’inama
y’abahawe ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu
n’iz’ubutegetsi, ibyemezo ndakuka,
amasezerano y’inyongera, imyanzuro,
ibyifuzonama n’ibitekerezo byatanzwe,
bigomba gutegurwa mu ndimi zemewe
z’Umuryango, mu buryo bunganya agaciro mu
myandikire no mu bikubiyemo.
238. (2) Izindi nyandiko zose z’izi nama
zitangwa mu ndimi z’akazi z’Umuryango.
239. 3. (1) Inyandiko z’akazi zemewe
z’Umuryango nk’uko biteganywa mu
Mategeko agenga inzego z’Ubutegetsi,
zigomba gutangazwa mu ndimi eshanu
zemewe.
240. (2) Izindi nyandiko zose Umunyamabanga
Mukuru agomba gukwirakwiza muri rusange
zateguwe mu rwego rw’inshingano ze, zigomba
kwandikwa mu ndimi eshatu z’ akazi.
241. 4. Inyandiko izo ari zo zose zivugwa muri
nomero ya 237 kugeza 240 zishobora
gutangazwa mu ndimi zitari izivugwa muri izo
nomero, hitawe ko Abanyamuryango shingiro
cyangwa Abanyamuryango bungirije basaba
ko zitangazwa bemera kwishyura amafaranga
yose akoreshwa mu gusemura izo nyandiko no
kuzitangaza.
242. 5. (1) Mu nama z’Umuryango kandi igihe
cyose bibaye ngombwa mu nama z’inzego
zihoraho zawo ndetse n’Inama y’Ubutegetsi,
ibiganiro mpaka bikorwa hifashishijwe uburyo
buboneye bwo gusemura, mu buryo bwa
magirirane, hagati y’indimi eshatu zikoreshwa
mu kazi n’ururimi rw’Ikirusiya.
243. (2) Iyo abitabiriye inama bose
babyumvikanyeho, impaka zishobora kugibwa
mu ndimi zitageze kuri enye zavuzwe haruguru.
244. 6. (1) Mu nama z’Umuryango no mu nama
z’inzego zihoraho zawo n’inama z’ubutegetsi,
indimi zitari izavuzwe muri nomero ya 235
n’iya 242 zishobora gukoreshwa:
245. (a) iyo habayeho gusaba Umunyamabanga
Mukuru cyangwa Umuyobozi w’urwego
ruhoraho bireba ko hakoreshwa urundi rurimi
cyangwa izindi ndimi, mu buryo bwo kuvuga
cyangwa bw’inyandiko, hagendewe ko
amafaranga yiyongera, ku bw’izo mpamvu,
yishyurwa n’Abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije babisabye
cyangwa bashyigikiye ubusabe ;
246. (b) iyo itsinda ry’intumwa iryo ari ryo
ryose ryateguye, rikoresheje amafaranga yaryo,
kugira ngo habeho gusemura ururimi rwabo
rujya mu ndimi zivugwa muri nomero ya 242.
247. (2) Mu gihe habaye ibiteganyijwe muri
nomero ya 245, Umunyamabanga Mukuru
cyangwa Umuyobozi w'urwego ruhoraho
bireba yubahiriza ubwo busabe mu buryo
bushoboka bwose, nyuma yo kubanza kubona
inyandiko yemeza ko Abanyamuryango
shingiro cyangwa Abanyamuryango bungirije
bireba bazasubiza, mu buryo budasubirwaho,
mu Muryango amafaranga yakoreshwejwe.
248. (3) Mu gihe habaye ibiteganyijwe muri
nomero ya 246, itsinda ry’intumwa bireba
rishobora, kandi iyo ribyifuza, gutegura,
ryishingiye ubwaryo ikiguzi cyabyo, ko habaho
ubusemuzi bujyana mu rurimi rwabo buva muri
rumwe mu ndimi zivugwa muri nomero ya 242.
UMUTWE WA II: GUSHYIRA MU
BIKORWA AMASEZERANO
MPUZAMAHANGA N'AMATEGEKO

articles.heading: Kwemeza burundu Amasezerano mpuzamahanga 249. 1. Aya Masezerano yemezwa burundu na Guverinoma zayashyizeho umukono
articles.text:
hakurikijwe Amategeko Nshinga akurikizwa
mu bihugu byazo. Inyandiko zo kuyemeza
burundu zishyikirizwa mu gihe gito gishoboka,
Umunyamabanga Mukuru hakoreshejwe inzira
za dipolomasi binyujijwe mu buhuza bwa
Guverinoma y’igihugu Umuryango ufitemo
icyicaro. Umunyamabanga Mukuru amenyesha
abanyamuryango shingiro n’abanyamuryango
bungirije ibijyanye na buri tangwa ry’inyandiko
yo kwemezwa burundu.
250. 2. (1) Mu gihe cy’imyaka ibiri uhereye ku
itariki aya Masezerano yatangiye gukurikizwa,
igihugu cyayashyizeho umukono, nubwo
gishobora kuba kitaratanze inyandiko yo
kuyemeza burundu nk’uko biteganywa muri
nomero ya 249, kigira uburenganzira buhabwa
abanyamuryango b’Umuryango nk’uko
biteganywa muri nomero ya 12 kugeza ku ya
14.
251. (2) Kuva igihe cy’imyaka ibiri kirangiye
uhereye ku itariki aya Masezerano
mpuzamahanga atangiye gukurikizwa,
Guverinoma yayashyizeho umukono ariko
itaratanga inyandiko yo kuyemeza burundu
nk’uko biteganywa muri nomero ya 249,
ntizaba ifite uburenganzira bwo gutora mu
nama iyo ari yo yose y’Umuryango, cyangwa
mu nama iyo ari yo yose y’inzego zihoraho
z’Umuryango, cyangwa mu kugisha inama iyo
ari yo yose yakozwe mu nyandiko hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa mu Masezerano mpuzamahanga
kugeza ubwo izaba yamaze gutanga iyo
nyandiko. Uburenganzira bwayo, uretse ubwo
gutora, ntibubangamirwa.
252. 3. Nyuma yo gutangira gukurikiza aya
Masezerano mpuzamahanga hashingiwe ku
biteganywa mu ngingo ya 53, buri nyandiko yo
kuyemeza burundu igira agaciro ku itariki
yashyikirijweho Umunyamabanga Mukuru.
253. 4. Iyo Guverinoma imwe cyangwa nyinshi
zashyizeho umukono zitemeje burundu aya
Masezerano mpuzamahanga, ibyo ntibigabanya
agaciro kayo ku bihugu byayemeje burundu.

articles.heading: Kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano mpuzamahanga 254. 1. Guverinoma y’igihugu, kitari
articles.text:
icyashyize umukono kuri aya Masezerano
mpuzamahanga, ishobora kwemera kuba
kimwe mu bihugu biyahuriyeho, igihe icyo ari
cyo cyose hashingiwe ku biteganywa n’ingingo
ya mbere.
255. 2. Inyandiko yo kwemera kuba kimwe mu
bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
ishyikirizwa Umunyamabanga Mukuru
binyuze mu nzira za dipolomasi binyujijwe mu
buhuza bwa Guverinoma y’igihugu
Umuryango ufitemo icyicaro. Uretse iyo
byavuzwe ukundi, uko kwemera gukurikizwa
guhera ku munsi wo kohereza inyandiko.
Umunyamabanga Mukuru amenyesha
abanyamuryango shingiro n’abanyamuryango
bungirije ibijyanye na buri kwemera kuba
kimwe mu bihugu biyahuriyeho yakiriye kandi
akoherereza buri Guverinoma inyandukuro
ihuje n’umwimerere yo kwemera kuba kimwe
mu bihugu biyahuriyeho.

articles.heading: Gushyira mu bikorwa aya Masezerano mu bihugu bigize Umuryango cyangwa intara imibanire yazo n’amahanga
articles.text:
ishinzwe ibihugu bigize Umuryango
256. 1. Abanyamuryango b’Umuryango
bashobora gutangaza igihe icyo ari cyo cyose
ko kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye
kuri aya Masezerano kwabo gukurikizwa kuri
bose cyangwa itsinda cyangwa kimwe mu
bihugu cyangwa intara bishinzwe imibanire
mpuzamahanga yazo.
257. 2. Itangazo ryakozwe hakurikijwe
ibiteganyijwe muri nomero ya 256
rimenyeshwa Umunyamabanga Mukuru, na we
akamenyesha Abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije ibyerekeye iryo
tangazo.
258. 3. Ibivugwa muri nomero ya 256 n’iya 257
ntibifatwa nk’ibitegetswe ku gihugu icyo ari
cyo cyose, intara cyangwa itsinda ry’intara
zagaragajwe mu Mugereka wa Mbere w’aya
Masezerano.

articles.heading: Gushyira mu bikorwa Amasezerano ku ntara zishingiwe n’Umuryango w'Abibumbye 259. Umuryango w’Abibumbye ufite
articles.text:
uburenganzira bwo kwemera kuba umwe mu
bahuriye kuri aya Masezerano mu izina
ry’intara iyo ari yo yose cyangwa itsinda
ry’intara ziyoborwa na wo hakurikijwe
amasezerano y’ubwishingizi nk'uko
biteganywa n’ingingo ya 75 y’Amasezerano
mpuzamahanga ashyiraho Umuryango
w’Abibumbye.

articles.heading: Ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’Amasezerano mpuzamahanga n'amabwiriza 260. 1. Abanyamuryango shingiro
articles.text:
n’abanyamuryango bungirije bafite inshingano
zo gukurikiza ibiteganywa n’aya Masezerano
hamwe n’Amabwiriza ari ku Mugereka wayo,
mu biro byose na za sitasiyo zose by’itumanaho
byashyizweho cyangwa bikoreshwa na byo,
bikora mu rwego mpuzamahanga cyangwa
bishobora gutera ihungabana rikomeye muri
serivisi za radiyo z’ibindi bihugu, uretse ku
bijyanye na serivisi zisonewe izo nshingano
nk’uko biteganywa n’ingingo ya 51 y’aya
Masezerano.
261. 2. Bagomba kandi gufata ingamba za
ngombwa zituma ibigo byahaye uburenganzira
bwo gushyiraho no gukora serivisi z’itumanaho
kandi bikora serivisi z’itumanaho
mpuzamahanga cyangwa bikoresha sitasiyo
zishobora gutuma habaho kwivanga
kw’itumanaho rya serivisi za radiyo z’ibindi
bihugu, byubahiriza ibiteganywa n’aya
Masezerano n’ibiteganywa n’Amabwiriza ari
ku Mugereka wayo.

articles.heading: Ukwivana mu Masezerano 262. 1. Buri munyamuryango shingiro n’umumunyamuryango wungirije wemeje
articles.text:
burundu cyangwa wemeye kuba umwe mu
bahuriye kuri aya Masezerano afite
uburenganzira bwo kuyivanamo binyuze mu
imenyesha yoherereza Umunyamabanga
Mukuru hakoreshejwe inzira za dipolomasi
biciye ku buhuza bwa Guverinoma y’igihugu
Umuryango ufitemo icyicaro.
Umunyamabanga Mukuru abimenyesha abandi
banyamuryango shingiro n’abanyamuryango
bungirije.
263. 2. Uku kwivana mu Masezerano kugira
agaciro ku irangira ry’umwaka umwe uhereye
ku munsi Umunyamabanga Mukuru yakiriyeho
imenyesha.

articles.heading: Ukwivana mu Masezerano mpuzamahanga mu izina ry’ibihugu cyangwa intara imibanire yabyo mpuzamahanga ishinzwe ibihugu bigize
articles.text:
Umuryango
264. 1. Ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’aya
Masezerano mpuzamahanga ku gihugu, intara
cyangwa itsinda ry’intara nk’uko biteganywa
n’Ingingo ya 20, rishobora guhagarikwa igihe
icyo ari cyo cyose, kandi icyo gihugu, iyo ntara
cyangwa iryo tsinda ry’intara, iyo ari
umunyamuryngo wungirije, ahita atakaza uwo
mwanya akimara guhagarika ishyirwa mu
bikorwa ryayo.
265. 2. Itangazo ryo kwivana muri aya
Masezerano riteganyijwe mu gika cyavuzwe
haruguru rimenyeshwa hakurikijwe ibivugwa
muri nomero ya 262 ; rigira agaciro hakurikijwe
ibivugwa muri nomero ya 263.

articles.heading: Ivanwaho ry’Amasezerano yabanjirije aya 266. Aya Masezerano akuraho kandi asimbura, mu mibanire hagati ya Guverinoma
articles.text:
ziyahuriyeho, Amasezerano mpuzamahanga
y’itumanaho (Geneve, 1959).

articles.heading: Agaciro k'Amabwiriza y'Ubutegetsi akurikizwa 267. Amabwiriza y’Ubutegetsi avugwa muri nomero ya 203 ni ayakurikizwaga mu gihe cyo
articles.text:
gushyira umukono kuri aya Masezerano.
Afatwa nk’umugereka w’aya Masezerano
mpuzamahanga kandi akomeza kugira agaciro,
haseguriwe amavugururwa y’igice cyayo
ashobora kwemezwa hashingiwe ku
biteganywa n’ingingo ya 52 kugeza igihe
amabwiriza mashya yashyizweho n’inama
z’ubutegetsi zibifitiye ububasha ku isi atangiye
gukurikizwa kugira ngo ayasimbure
nk’imigereka kuri aya Masezerano.

articles.heading: Umubano n’ibihugu bitari muri aya Masezerano 268. 1. Buri Munyamuryango shingiro n’umunyamuryango wungirije agumana
articles.text:
uburenganzira kuri we no ku bigo byemewe
byigenga by’itumanaho, bwo gushyiraho
ibisabwa kugira ngo bemere itumanaho
ryoherejwe n’Igihugu kitari muri aya
Masezerano.
269. 2. Iyo itumanaho rituruka ku butaka
bw’Igihugu kitari muri aya aya Masezerano
ryakiriwe n’Umunyamuryango shingiro
cyangwa umunyamuryango wungirije, rigomba
koherezwa kandi, mu gihe ricishijwe mu
miyoboro y’itumanaho y’Umunyamuryango
shingiro cyangwa Umunyamuryango
wungirije, ibiteganywa n’aya Masezerano
n’ibiteganywa n’aya mabwiriza bitegetswe
ndetse n’amafaranga asanzwe asabwa bigomba
kubahirizwa.

articles.heading: Gukemura impaka 270. 1. Abanyamuryango shingiro n’abanyamuryango bungirije bashobora gukemura impaka zabo ku bibazo bijyanye
articles.text:
n’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’aya Masezerano
cyangwa amabwiriza ateganyijwe mu ngingo
ya 15, binyuze mu nzira za dipolomasi,
cyangwa hakurikijwe uburyo bwashyizweho
n’amasezerano hagati y'ibihugu bibiri cyangwa
amasezerano hagati y’ibihugu byinshi
byayagiranye kugira ngo bikemure impaka
mpuzamahanga, cyangwa hakoreshejwe
ubundi buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose
byumvikanyeho.
271. 2. Iyo nta buryo na bumwe bwo gukemura
impaka bwakurikijwe, buri Munyamuryango
shingiro cyangwa Umunyamuryango wungirije
urebwa n’amakimbirane ashobora kuyajyana
mu bukemurampaka hakurikijwe uburyo
buteganywa mu Mugereka wa 3, cyangwa mu
Masezerano y’Inyongera, akurikije uko ikibazo
giteye.
UMUTWE WA III: IMIBANIRE
N’UMURYANGO W’ABIBUMBYE
N’IMIRYANGO MPUZAMAHANGA

articles.heading: Imibanire n’Umuryango w’Abibumbye 272. 1. Imibanire hagati y’Umuryango w’Abibumbye n’Umuryango Mpuzamahanga
articles.text:
w’Itumanaho isobanurwa mu Masezerano
yakozwe hagati y’iyi miryango yombi.
273. 2. Hakurikijwe ibivugwa mu ngingo ya
XVI y’amasezerano yavuzwe haruguru, serivisi
zo gukoresha itumanaho z’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye zifite uburenganzira kandi
zigengwa n’inshingano z’aya Masezerano
mpuzamahanga n’iz’amabwiriza y’ubutegetsi
ari ku mugereka wayo. Kubera iyo mpamvu,
abazikoramo bafite uburenganzira bwo
kwitabira inama zose z’Umuryango, harimo
n’inama za Komite Mpuzamahanga
Ngishwanama, mu rwego rw’ubujyanama.

articles.heading: Imibanire n’imiryango mpuzamahanga 274. Mu rwego rwo gushyira mu bikorwa guhuza ibikorwa mpuzamahanga byuzuye ku
articles.text:
bibazo bijyanye n’itumanaho, Umuryango
ukorana n’imiryango mpuzamahanga ifite
inyungu n’ibikorwa bifitanye isano.
UMUTWE WA IV: INGINGO RUSANGE
ZIJYANYE N'ITUMANAHO

articles.heading: Uburenganzira bw’abantu bose mu bijyanye no gukoresha Serivisi Mpuzamahanga z’Itumanaho 275. Abanyamuryango shingiro
articles.text:
n’abanyamuryango bungirije bemera
uburenganzira bw’abaturage bwo
kohererezanya ubutumwa binyuze muri serivisi
mpuzamahanga rusange zo kohererezanya
ubutumwa. Serivisi, amafaranga asabwa
n’ingamba z’ubwirinzi bigomba kuba bimwe
ku bakoresha bose serivisi bo muri buri cyiciro
cy’itumanaho ryo kwandikirana, nta mwihariko
cyangwa ubusumbane mu guhabwa serivisi.

articles.heading: Guhagarika Itumanaho 276. 1. Abanyamuryango shingiro n’abanyamuryango bungirije bafite uburenganzira bwo guhagarika kohereza
articles.text:
ubutumwa ubwo ari bwo bwose bwa
telegaramu bw'ibanga bugaragara ko bushobora
kubangamira umutekano w'Igihugu cyangwa
bushobora kuba bunyuranyije n'amategeko
yabo, ituze rusange rya rubanda cyangwa
umuco, hitawe ko bahita bamenyesha ibiro
by'aho ubwo butumwa bw'ibanga buturuka
ibijyanye n’uko guhagarika ubutumwa ubwo
ari bwo bwose cyangwa igice cyabwo icyo ari
cyo cyose, keretse iyo iryo menyesha
bigaragara ko ryabangamira umutekano
w'Igihugu.
277. 2. Abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije na bo bafite
uburenganzira bwo guhagarika itumanaho iryo
ari ryo ryose ry’ibanga rishobora kugaragara
nk’aho ribangamiye umutekano w’igihugu
cyangwa rinyuranyije n’amategeko yabyo,
ituze rusange rya rubanda cyangwa imico
myiza.

articles.heading: Guhagarika serivisi 278. Buri Munyamuryango shingiro n’Umunyamuryango wungirije bafite uburenganzira bwo guhagarika serivisi
articles.text:
y’itumanaho mpuzamahanga mu gihe kitazwi,
haba muri rusange cyangwa gusa ku mibanire
imwe n'imwe na/cyangwa ku bwoko
bw’itumanaho, ryoherejwe, ryakiriwe cyangwa
riri mu nzira, hitawe ko ahita amenyesha buri
Munyamuryango shingiro n'Umunyamuryango
wungirije icyo cyemezo binyuze ku
Munyamabanga Mukuru.

articles.heading: Inshingano 279. Abanyamuryango shingiro n’abanyamuryango bungirije ntibemera inshingano zijyanye n’abakoresha serivisi
articles.text:
mpuzamahanga z’itumanaho, cyane cyane ku
bijyanye n’ibirego by’indishyi.

articles.heading: Ibanga ry'itumanaho 280. 1. Abanyamuryango shingiro n’abanyamuryango bungirije bemera gufata
articles.text:
ingamba zose zishoboka, zijyanye na gahunda
y’itumanaho ryakoreshejwe, hagamijwe ko
habaho ibanga ry’itumanaho mpuzamahanga
ryo mu buryo bw’inyandiko.
281. 2. Icyakora, bagumana uburenganzira bwo
kugeza ubwo butumwa bwanditse ku nzego
zibifitiye ububasha kugira ngo zirebe ko
amategeko yazo y'imbere mu gihugu ashyirwa
mu bikorwa cyangwa ko amasezerano
mpuzamahanga barimo ashyirwa mu bikorwa.

articles.heading: Ishyirwaho, ikoreshwa, no kurinda ibikorwaremezo n’imiyoboro by’itumanaho 282. 1. Abanyamuryango shingiro
articles.text:
n’abanyamuryango bungirije bagomba gufata
ingamba za ngombwa kugira ngo hashyirweho,
mu buryo bwiza cyane bushoboka, imiyoboro
n'ibikorwaremezo bikenewe kugira ngo
haboneke itumanaho mpuzamahanga ryihuta
kandi ridacikagurika.
283. 2. Iyo bishoboka, iyo miyoboro
n’ibikorwaremezo bigomba gukoreshwa
hakurikijwe uburyo n'imikorere byagaragaye
ko ari byo byiza cyane hagendewe ku mikorere
yabyo. Bigomba kubungabungwa mu buryo
bwiza bw’imikorere kandi bikabungabungwa
mu rwego rw'iterambere ry’ubumenyi na
tekiniki.
284. 3. Abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije bagomba kurinda
iyo miyoboro n’ibikorwaremezo biri mu mbago
z’ububasha bwabo.
285. 4. Uretse igihe hari ibindi biteganywa
n’amasezerano yihariye, buri Munyamuryango
shingiro n’umunyamuryango wungirije afata
ingamba zikenewe kugira ngo ashobore
gusigasira ibyo bice by’imiyoboro y’itumanaho
mpuzamahanga biri mu duce agenzura.

articles.heading: Imenyesha ryerekeye kutubahiriza ibiteganyijwe 286. Mu rwego rwo koroshya ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya 22 y’aya
articles.text:
Masezerano mpuzamahanga, Abanyamuryango
shingiro n’abanyamuryango bungirije
biyemeza kumenyeshanya ukutubahiriza
ibivugwa muri aya Masezerano mpuzamahanga
n’Amabwiriza ari ku mugereka wayo.

articles.heading: Amafaranga yishyurwa na serivisi zitangwa ku buntu 287. Ingingo zerekeye amafaranga yishyurwa
articles.text:
ku itumanaho n’ibikorwa binyuranye bituma
serivisi zitangwa ku buntu ziteganywa mu
Mabwiriza ari ku mugereka w’aya Masezerano.

articles.heading: Ibyihutirwa ku itumanaho ryerekeye umutekano w’ubuzima 288. Serivisi z’itumanaho mpuzamahanga
articles.text:
zigomba gushyira imbere byimazeyo
itumanaho ryose ryerekeye umutekano
w’ubuzima mu nyanja, ku butaka, mu kirere
cyangwa mu isanzure, ndetse n’itumanaho
ryihariye ryihutirwa ry’Ishami ry’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima rijyanye
n’ibyorezo.

articles.heading: Ibyihutirwa by’itumanaho rya telegaramu na telefone bya Leta 289. Haseguriwe ibivugwa mu ngingo ya 39
articles.text:
n'iya 49 z'aya Masezerano mpuzamahanga,
telegaramu za Guverimoma zigomba
gushyirwa imbere kuruta izindi igihe
uwohereza ubutumwa abisabye. Itumanaho rya
telefone rya Guverinoma rishobora kandi
gushyirwa imbere, igihe byasabwe
by’umwihariko kandi igihe bishoboka, kurusha
irindi tumanaho rya telefone.

articles.heading: Ururimi rw’ibanga 290. 1. Telegaramu za Guverinoma na serivisi ya telegaramu bishobora gutangwa mu rurimi
articles.text:
rw'ibanga mu mibanire yose.
291. 2. Ubutumwa bw’umuntu ku giti cye bwa
telegaramu butanzwe mu rurimi rw’ibanga
bushobora kwakirwa hagati y’ibihugu byose
usibye ibihugu byamenyesheje mbere, binyuze
ku Munyamabanga Mukuru, ko bitazemera
urwo rurimi kuri ibyo byiciro by’ubutumwa.
292. 3. Abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije batemera
ubutumwa bw’umuntu ku giti cye bwa
telegaramu buri mu rurimi rw’ibanga buturuka
cyangwa bwoherejwe ku butaka bwabo,
bagomba kubwemera mu gihe buri
kuhanyuzwa, keretse iyo byahagaritse serivisi
ziteganywa mu ngingo ya 33 y’aya Masezerano
mpuzamahanga.

articles.heading: Ishyirwaho rya konti no kwishyurana 293. 1. Ubuyobozi bw’abanyamuryango shingiro n’abanyamuryango bungirije n’ibigo
articles.text:
byigenga byemewe bikora serivisi
mpuzamahanga z’itumanaho, bemeranya
ingano y’amafaranga y’imyenda bafitiwe
n’ay’imyenda bafitiye abandi.
294. 2. Inyandiko za konti zerekeye amafaranga
y’imyenda baberewemo n’imyenda bafitiye
abandi zivugwa muri nomero ya 293 zikorwa
hashingiwe ku biteganywa n’amabwiriza ari ku
mugereka w’aya Masezerano, uretse iyo
habaye amasezerano yihariye hagati y’impande
bireba.
295. 3. Kwishyurana hakoreshejwe konti
mpuzamahanga gufatwa nk’ibikorwa
by’ubucuruzi byo mu gihe cya vuba, kandi
bikorwa hakurikijwe inshingano
mpuzamahanga za vuba ku bihugu bireba, mu
gihe Guverinoma zabyo zaba zaragiranye
amasezerano kuri icyo kibazo. Iyo nta
masezerano yakozwe, kandi hatabayeho
n’amasezerano yihariye nk’uko biteganywa mu
ngingo ya 44 y’aya Masezerano
mpuzamahanga, uko kwishyurana gukorwa
hakurikijwe Amabwiriza.

articles.heading: Urugero fatizo rw’ifaranga 296. Urugero fatizo rw’ifaranga rukoreshwa mu gutegura ibiciro bya serivisi
articles.text:
mpuzamahanga z’itumanaho no mu gushyiraho
konti mpuzamahanga ni ifaranga rya zahabu
rigizwe na santime 100, uburemere bwa 10/31
bya garama n’ubuyungururwe bwa 0.900.

articles.heading: Amasezerano yihariye 297. Abanyamuryango shingiro n’abanyamuryango bungirije bagira uburenganzira ubwabo ku bikorwa byo ku giti
articles.text:
cyabo byemewe na bo no ku bindi bigo
byahawe uburenganzira bwo gukora gutyo,
bwo kugirana amasezerano yihariye ku bibazo
by'itumanaho bitareba abanyamuryango
shingiro n’abanyamuryango bungirije muri
rusange. Amasezerano nk’ayo, icyakora
ntashobora kuvuguruzanya n’ibiteganywa
n’aya Masezerano mpuzamahanga cyangwa
Amabwiriza ari ku mugereka wayo, cyane
cyane ku bijyanye no kwivanga gukabije
kw’imirongo gushobora guterwa n’imikorere
yabyo bishobora kubangamira imikorere ya
serivisi za radiyo z’ibindi bihugu.

articles.heading: Inama, Amasezerano n’imiryango byo ku rwego rw’akarere 298. Abanyamuryango shingiro n’abanyamuryango bungirije bafite
articles.text:
uburenganzira bwo gutumiza inama zo ku
rwego rw’akarere, gukora amasezerano yo ku
rwego rw’akarere no gushinga imiryango yo ku
rwego rw’akarere, hagamijwe gukemura
ibibazo by’itumanaho bishobora gukemurwa
ku rwego rw’akarere. Ayo masezerano
ntashobora kuvuguruzanya n’ibiteganywa
n’aya Masezerano.
UMUTWE WA V: INGINGO ZIHARIYE
ZIJYANYE N’ITUMANAHO RYA
RADIYO

articles.heading: Imikoreshereze iboneye y’impuzamirongo ya radiyo 299. Abanyamuryango shingiro n’abanyamuryango bungirije bemera ko
articles.text:
bikwiye kugabanya umubare w’imirongo
n’umwanya w’impuzamirongo ukoreshwa iyo
gusa bikenewe kugira ngo hakorwe mu buryo
bukwiye serivisi zikenewe. Ku bw’ibyo,
birakwiye ko iterambere rya tekiniki rigezweho
rikoreshwa vuba bishoboka.

articles.heading: Gushyikirana mu itumanaho 300. 1. Sitasiyo zitanga itumanaho rikoresha insakazamajwi mu itumanaho rya serivisi
articles.text:
ngendanwa zubahiriza, mu birebwa
n’inshingano zazo zisanzwe, guhanahana
amakuru atangwa mu buryo bw’amajwi nta
tandukanyirizo rya gahunda ya radio yemewe
na zo.
301. 2 Icyakora, mu rwego rwo kutabangamira
iterambere ry’ubumenyi, ibivugwa muri
nomero ya 300 ntibishobora kubuza ikoreshwa
rya gahunda ya radiyo idashobora kuvugana
n’izindi gahunda, hashingiwe ko ubwo
bushobozi buke buterwa n’imiterere yihariye
y’izo gahunda kandi atari impamvu
y’ibikoresho byemewe gusa hagamijwe
gukumira gushyikirana mu itumanaho.
302. 3. Hatitawe ku bivugwa muri nomero ya
300, sitasiyo ishobora gushingwa serivisi
mpuzamahanga z’itumanaho zibujijwe,
zigenwa ku bw’intego y’iyi serivisi cyangwa ku
bw’ibindi bintu bitagendeye ku buryo
bukoreshwa.

articles.heading: Ukwivanga kw’imirongo kugira ingaruka mbi ku itumanaho 303. 1. Sitasiyo zose, intego izo ari zo zose zaba
articles.text:
zifite, zigomba gushyirwaho kandi
zigakoreshwa mu buryo budatera ukwivanga
kw’imirongo kugira ingaruka mbi mu
itumanaho cyangwa serivisi z’insakazamajwi
z’ibindi bihugu bigize Umuryango cyangwa
z’ibihugu bigize umuryango byungirije
cyangwa z’ibigo byigenga byemewe bikora
ibijyanye n’itumanaho cyangwa z’ibindi bigo
byahawe uburenganzira bwo gutanga serivisi
z’itumanaho, kandi bigakora bikurikije
ibiteganywa n’amabwiriza agenga itumanaho
rikoresha insakazamajwi.
304. 2. Buri munyamuryango shingiro
cyangwa umunyamuryango wungirije
yiyemeza gusaba ibigo byigenga bikora
ibikorwa by’itumanaho yemeye n’ibindi bigo
bikora ibikorwa by’itumanaho byahawe
uburenganzira ku bw’iyo mpamvu kubahiriza
ibikubiye muri nomero ya 303.
305 3 Byongeye, abanyamuryango shingiro
n’abanyamuryango bungirije bemera ko ari
ngombwa gufata ingamba zose zishoboka zo
gukumira ko imikorere y’ibikoresho
by’amashanyarazi n’ibikoresho bikoreshwa mu
itumanaho by’ubwoko bwose bidatera
ukwivanga kw’imirongo kugira ingaruka mbi
mu itumanaho cyangwa kwa serivisi
z’insakazamajwi cyangwa mu itumanaho
nk’uko bivugwa muri nomero ya 303.

articles.heading: Guhamagara n’Ubutumwa bw’ intabaza 306. Sitasiyo zishinzwe itumanaho rya radiyo zisabwa kwakira guhamagara n’ubutumwa
articles.text:
bw’intabaza nk’ikintu kihutirwa,
kidashidikanywa, aho bwaba buturutse hose,
ndetse no kubusubiza kandi zigahita zifata
icyemezo kijyanye na bwo bitewe n’ibisabwa.

articles.heading: Ibimenyetso by’intabaza, iby’ibyihutirwa, iby’umutekano cyangwa iby’ibiranga bitari nyabyo cyangwa
articles.text:
by’ibinyoma
307. Abanyamuryango shingiro cyangwa
abanyamuryango bungirije biyemeza gufata
ingamba zikenewe zo guhashya ihererekanya
cyangwa ikwirakwizwa ry’ibimenyetso
by’intabaza, iry’ibyihutirwa, iby’umutekano
cyangwa iby’ibiranga bitari nyabyo cyangwa
by'ibinyoma ndetse no gufatanya hagamijwe
kuranga no kugaragaza sitasiyo ziri mu bubasha
bwabo zikwirakwiza ibyo bimenyetso.

articles.heading: Ibikoresho bikoreshwa muri serivisi z’umutekano w’igihugu 308. 1. Abanyamuryango shingiro n’abanyamuryango bungirije bafite
articles.text:
ubwisanzure busesuye ku bijyanye
n’ibikoresho by’itumanaho ry’igisirikare cyabo
cyirwanira mu mazi cyangwa mu kirere.
309.2. Icyakora, ibyo bikoresho, bigomba
kubahiriza ibiteganywa n’amabwiriza
yerekeranye n’ubufasha butangwa mu gihe
havutse ibibazo ndetse n’ingamba zafatwa
kugira ngo hatabaho ukwivanga kw’imirongo
kugira ingaruka mbi ku itumanaho, n’ibikubiye
mu mabwiriza yerekeranye n’uburyo bwo
gutambutsa amajwi n’ubwoko bw’imirongo
y’itumanaho igomba gukoreshwa, bitewe
n’imiterere ya serivisi bitanga.
310. 3. Byongeye kandi, iyo ibyo bikoresho
bigira uruhare muri serivisi yo guhererekanya
amakuru mu buryo bwa rusange cyangwa mu
zindi serivisi zigengwa n’amabwiriza ari ku
mugereka w’aya Masezerano, bigomba
kubahiriza, muri rusange, ibiteganywa
n’amabwiriza akurikizwa muri izo serivisi.
UMUTWE WA VI: IBISOBANURO

articles.heading: Ibisobanuro 311. Muri aya Masezerano, uretse iyo ahinduye ibisobanuro bitewe n’imitere y’aho
articles.text:
yakoreshejwe :
(a) amagambo asobanurwa mu Mugereka wa 2
w'aya Masezerano agira ibisobanuro yahawe
kuri uwo Mugereka;
312. (b) andi magambo asobanurwa mu
Mabwiriza avugwa mu ngingo ya 15 agira
ibisobanuro yahawe muri iyo ngingo
UMUTWE WA VII: INGINGO ZISOZA

articles.heading: Itariki Amasezerano atangirira gukurikizwa 313. Aya Masezerano atangira gukurikizwa ku wa mbere Mutarama mu mwaka w’igihumbi
articles.text:
kimwe magana cyenda na mirongo itandatu na
karindwi hagati y’ibihugu, intara cyangwa
amatsinda y’intara, inyandiko yo kuyemeza
burundu cyangwa yo kwemera kuba kimwe mu
bihugu, intara cyangwa amatsinda y’intara
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano yatanzwe mbere
y’iyo tariki.
BAMAZE KWEMERA IBIKUBIYE MURI
AYA MASEZERANO, abahawe ububasha
bahagarariye ibihugu byabo bashyize umukono
kuri kopi imwe y’aya Masezerano iri muri buri
rurimi rw’Igishinwa, Icyongereza, Igifaransa,
Ikirusiya n’Icyesipanyolo, mu gihe habaye
impaka, inyandiko y’ururimi rw’Igifaransa ni
yo igira agaciro, kandi akomeza kubikwa mu
ishyinguranyandiko ry’Umuryango
Mpuzamahanga w’Itumanaho, na wo ugomba
kohereza kopi kuri buri gihugu cyayashyizeho
umukono.
Bikorewe i Montreux, ku wa 12 Ugushyingo
1965.
AMASEZERANO Y’INYONGERA
NDAKUKA KU MASEZERANO
MPUZAMAHANGA YEREKERANYE
N’ITUMANAHO (MONTREUX, 1965)
Mu gihe cyo gushyira umukono ku
Masezerano Mpuzamahanga yerekeranye
n’itumanaho (Montreux, 1965), abahawe
ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu byabo
bazirikana inyandiko zikurikira zigize
ibyemezo ndakuka by’Inama y’abahawe
ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu (Montreux,
1965):
I. Ku bwa Afuganisitani:
Intumwa za Guverinoma y’Ubwami bwa
Afuganisitani mu Nama y’abahawe ububash
bahagarariye ibihugu byabo mu Nama
y’Umuryango Mpuzamahanga w’Itumanaho
(Montreux, 1965) zigira, ku bwa
Guverinoma yazo, uburenganzira bwo
kutemera ingamba izo ari zo zose z’imari
zishobora gutuma umugabane w’imisanzu
wayo wiyongera hagamijwe kwishyura
amafaranga yakoreshejwe n’Umuryango, no
gufata ingamba izo ari zo zose zishobora
kubona ko ari ngombwa mu rwego rwo
kurinda serivisi z’itumanaho zabo iyo hari
umunyamuryango shingiro cyangwa
umunyamuryango wungirije wananiwe
kubahiriza ibiteganywa mu Masezerano
mpuzamahanga yerekeranye n’itumanaho
(Montreux,1965).
II: Ku bw’Alijeriya (Repubulika ya
Demokarasi kandi ya Rubanda ya Alijeriya) :
Intumwa za Repubulika ya Demokarasi
kandi ya Rubanda ya Alijeriya mu Nama
y’abahawe ububasha bahagarariye ibihugu
byabo y’Umuryango mpuzamahanga
w’Itumanaho (Malaga-Torremolinos, 1973)
zigira uburenganzira, mu izina rya
Guverinoma yazo, bwo gufata ingamba izo
ari zo zose zishobora kubona ko zikenewe
mu rwego rwo kurengera inyungu zazo, mu
gihe bamwe mu banyamuryango batubahirije
mu buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose ibiteganywa
n’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga yerekeranye
n’Itumanaho (Malaga-Torremolinos, 1973),
cyangwa mu gihe ukwifata kwakozwe
n’abandi banyamuryango kwabangamira
serivisi z’itumanaho zazo cyangwa kwatera
izamuka ry’umugabane wa Alijeriya mu
gutanga amafaranga akoreshwa
n’Umuryango.
III: Ku bwa Alijeriya (Repubulika ya
Demokarasi kandi ya rubanda), Ubwami
bwa Arabiya Sawudite, Repubulika ya Iraki,
Ubwami bwa Hashemite bwa Yorodaniya,
Leta ya Koweti, Libani, Ubwami bwa
Maroke, Repubulika y'Abarabu ya Siriya,
Repubulika Yunze Ubumwe y'Abarabu,
Repubulika ya Sudani na Tuniziya:
Intumwa zavuzwe haruguru zitangaza ko
gushyira umukono, no kwemeza burundu aya
Masezerano mpuzamahanga (Montreux,
1965), gushobora gukorwa nyuma na
Guverinoma zazo, bidafite agaciro ku
bijyanye n’Umunyamuryango ugaragara ku
mugereka wa mbere w’aya Masezerano ku
izina rya Isiraheli, kandi ibyo ntibisobanura
na gato ko icyo gihugu cyemewe.
IV: Kuri Alijeriya (Repubulika ya
Demokarasi ya Alijeriya kandi ya Rubanda),
Repubulika ya Kameruni, Repubulika ya
Centrafrique, Repubulika Iharanira
Demokarasi ya Kongo, Repubulika ya Kongo
(Brazzaville), Repubulika ya Côte d'Ivoire,
Repubulika ya Dahomey, Etiyopiya,
Repubulika ya Gabon, Gana, Repubulika ya
Gineya, Repubulika ya Haute-Volta,Kenya,
Repubulika ya Liberiya, Malawi, Repubulika
ya Madagasikari, Repubulika ya Mali,
Ubwami bwa Maroke, Repubulika ya
Kiyisilamu ya Moritaniya, Repubulika ya
Nijeri, Repubulika Yunze Ubumwe ya
Nijeriya, Ubugande, Repubulika Zunze
Ubumwe z’Abarabu, Repubulika ya
Somaliya, Repubulika y’u Rwanda,
Repubulika ya Senegali, Sierra Leone,
Repubulika ya Sudani, Repubulika Yunze
Ubumwe ya Tanzaniya, Repubulika ya Cadi,
Repubulika ya Togo, Tuniziya, na Repubulika
ya Zambiya:
Intumwa z’ibihugu byavuzwe haruguru
zitangaza ko gushyira umukono wazo ku
Masezerano Mpuzamahanga yerekeranye
n’Itumanaho (Montreux, 1965) no kwemeza
burundu nyuma ayo Masezerano bikozwe na
za Guverinoma zabyo, nta na rimwe
bisobanura ko ibyo bihugu byemera
Guverinoma iriho ya Repubulika ya Afurika
y’Epfo, kandi ntibishyira inshingano iyo ari
yo yose kuri iyo Guverinoma.
V: Kuri Repubulika ya Arijantine:
Intumwa za Arijantine zitangaza:
Amasezerano mpuzamahanga yerekeranye
n’Itumanaho (Montreux, 1965) ateganya
muri nomero ya 4 ko igihugu icyo ari cyo
cyose cyangwa itsinda ry’intara biri ku
mugereka wa mbere ari ibigize Umuryango.
Umugereka wa mbere ugaragaza intara
z’amahanga ziri mu nshingano za
Guverinoma y’ubwami bw’Ubwongereza na
Irelande ya Ruguru mu bijyanye n’imibanire
mpuzamahanga.
Nk’uko bisanzwe bimenyerewe,
Guverinoma ivugwa ishyira muri iri tsinda
ry’intara "Ibirwa bya Falkland n’uduce
twabyo " na "intara z’Ubwongereza za
Antarigitika".
Intumwa za Arijantine zitangaza ku
mugaragaro ko icyo gikorwa nta na rimwe
gishobora kugira ingaruka ku busugire bwa
Arijantine ahagana ku Birwa bya Malvinas,
Ibirwa bya Sandwich y’Amajyepfo n’Ibirwa
bya Georgia y’Amajyepfo, byigaruriwe
n’Ubwongereza ikoresheje imbaraga, ibintu
Guverinoma ya Arijantine itigeze yemera na
rimwe. Ibi byemejwe na none, aho
Guverinoma ya Arijantine yongera kwemeza
uburenganzira ntavogerwa bwa Repubulika
ya Arijantine, kandi zitangaza ko izo ntara
n’ubutaka biri mu ntara ya Arijantine yo
muri Antaragitika atari koloni cyangwa
umutungo w’igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose
ahubwo bigize igice cy’intara ya Arijantine.
Ku bijyanye n’izina ryakoreshejwe muri iyo
nyandiko hagamijwe gusobanura Ibirwa bya
Malouines, intumwa za Arijantine zibona ko
ari ngombwa kongera kwibutsa icyemezo
cya Komite yihariye y’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye ishinzwe gusuzuma ishyirwa
mu bikorwa ry’itangazo ryerekeye guha
ubwigenge ibihugu byakoronijwe
n’abaturage babyo. Iyi Komite, mu kwemeza
ku bw’amasezerano rusange raporo
y’akanama ka III ku birebana n’Ibirwa bya
Malouines, ku wa 13 Ugushyingo 1964,
yafashe umwanzuro wemejwe ku bwiganze
bw’amajwi y’uko ijambo "Malouines"
rigomba kwandikwa rikurikiye izina
"Falkland" mu nyandiko zose z’iyi Komite
yihariye. Icyifuzo cyari uko uwo mwanzuro
w’ubwumvikane wagirwa ihame mu
nyandiko zose z’Umuryango w’Abibumbye.
Iri tangazo rigomba gufatwa nk’irireba
n’izindi nyito z’icyo cyiciro zishobora kuba
zarashyizwe muri aya Masezerano
mpuzamahanga cyangwa mu Migereka yayo.
VI: Kuri Repubulika ya Arijantine, Boliviya,
Burezili, Chili, Repubulika ya Kolombiya,
Kosta Rika, Ekwateri, Guatemala, Mexique,
Nikaragwa, Panama, Paraguay, Peru na
Repubulika ya Venezuwela:
Intumwa zavuzwe haruguru zitangaza ko
zitemera ihame ry'uko Abanyamuryango
